articleTitle: Grafana as a Visualization Tool for Measurements
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: The article highlights the advantages of using the Grafana platform using the example of measurements involving particulate matter, volatile organic compounds, temperature, humidity, pressure, and wind speed. The intuitive and clear features offered by Grafana are similarly applicable in any field of research where a large cloud of measured data is processed, which can be clearly displayed by selecting the appropriate time period.

articleTitle: Application of Mixture design in optimization of physical properties of slag during self-shielded flux-cored wire arc welding process
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: The analysis of recent publications showed the importance of optimising the slag system during the flux-cored arc welding. It was determined that it is rational to use two parameters to optimize the slag composition: viscosity and surface tension. The simplex-augmented-centroid mixture design was applied to identify the optimal formulation from the three core filler components CaO+CaF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>, TiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> and SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>. The results showed that high welding and processing properties would be ensured at the following slag component ratios: CaF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> + CaO = 0.30 … 0.70; SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> = 0.20 … 0.55; TiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> = 0.10 … 0.20.

articleTitle: Analysis of Climatic Conditions and the Values of Touch and Step Voltages on the Shock Currents Occurring During the Operation of the Grounding Grid in the LVDC Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: The development and increasing use of renewable energy sources has revived interest in low-voltage direct current (LVDC) networks. Their use reduces the number of used inverters, which affects both the cost of construction and operation, the efficiency of transmission and distribution of electricity, the elimination of problems related to reactive power and the reduction of the negative impact on the quality of electricity. The use of LVDC networks also has an impact on electric shock protection. The basic element of protection against electric shock, as in the case of alternating current networks, are earth electrodes. The pathophysiological effects of the shock current flow are affected by such factors as: earth electrode resistance, potential distribution on the ground surface - determining the values of step and touch voltages, and the path of flow through the human body. The paper presents an analysis of the impact of climate on the values of shock currents in the case of short-circuit current flowing to the earthing in the LVDC network.

articleTitle: Determining Disc Springs Stack Mechanical Characteristics of the Power Accumulator for Turbine Generator Core Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: In this paper present results of the calculation disc springs stack mechanical characteristics of the power accumulator. The design of the package of disk springs is use in the power accumulators for monitoring stator core pressure of a powerful turbine generator (TG) and it’s stabilization to the specified level without additional control with probes and fix by tightening nuts regulation. Results of an analytical review of methods and techniques of restoring and stabilizing the pressing force of the stator core of a powerful TG during operation presented. The advantages and features of the use of power accumulators (PA) with stack of disk springs for pressure stabilization that installed under the tightening nuts or instead of them on the threaded ends of the tightening prisms described. For calculate the mechanical characteristics of the plate spring unit used of TG and PA known parameters. Optimal method of assembling disc springs into stack in PA combined. Based on the specified design parameters, the dependence of the force created by single disc spring and a spring’s stack on the thickness of the spring obtained. The dependence of the force of the springs stack on the displacement of the pressure plate of the stator core for different values of the spring thickness was determined. The method for calculating the strength of disc springs stack given.

articleTitle: Study of the Influence of Sliding Mode Regulator on Spectrum Higher Harmonics of the SEPIC Converter
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: The article presents a study of the dynamic characteristics of a DC-DC converter of the SEPIC type. A model of the SEPIC converter with a sliding mode regulator is presented. The obtained research results show quite high dynamic indicators and ensure high speed of the regulation system, as well as its stability. The implementation of the SEPIC converter sliding mode regulator significantly improves the indicators of the ripple coefficient and the harmonic distortion coefficient of the input current and output voltage of the DC-DC converter.

articleTitle: Calculation of Optimal Geometric Parameters Electrical Apparatus for Controlling the Irrigation System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: The reduction of size in electrical apparatus is a critical objective in the design and utilization of irrigation systems, especially for traction electric drives employed in sprinkler machines. In this study, mathematical models were developed using the target function method, integrating relative measures of technical level and relative geometric controlled variables, to quantify the mass and cost of an armored electromagnetic system. Through optimization of the target functions, extreme values corresponding to mass and cost criteria were derived. Additionally, the validity of the mathematical models was assessed by comparing the obtained data with a real sample of the electrical apparatus.

articleTitle: High-Quality Digital Bichronous Education for Nanoengineers During the War in Ukraine: Does Technology Knowledge Matter?
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: This article is dedicated to the investigation of the impact of digitalization on the quality of bichronous education during the war in Ukraine, specifically focusing on students' perception of classical courses and courses with modern technologies implemented. We present a case study on the preparation of future nanoengineers in a Ukrainian university during wartime. The research compares the level of student satisfaction with the teaching and mastering of classical disciplines and those disciplines whose content and forms have been digitalized and updated using artificial intelligence. The article demonstrates that digitalization contributes to a higher level of student satisfaction from education and also raises questions about the fact that teachers often lack the flexibility and readiness to perceive innovations that students are well-versed in.

articleTitle: Simulation of Radiation Intensity Distribution of LED Matrices with Different Bases of Mounting Surfaces
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: This article discusses the modeling of the working surface of the irradiation intensity, formed by LED arrays of various configurations, namely flat, cylindrical and spherical structures. The ability to change the step of the LED matrix, the size of the surface of the frame and the parameters of the spatial distribution of the luminous intensity of an individual LED allows you to choose rational parameters for the design of the matrix to create an illumination value within the specified limits in the working area.

articleTitle: A Tool that Forms the Optimal Properties of the Surfaces of Sliding Contacts of Electrical Machines
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: The formation of the optimal properties of the surfaces of sliding contacts of electrical machines is extremely important. The solution to this problem provides an increase in the durability and operational reliability of modern machines. To the greatest extent, this applies to electric machines and electric vehicles, the operation of which is associated with the use of high-current sliding contacts. Brush-collector and brush-slip ring are two modifications of the sliding contacts of electrical machines. The integrated use of scientific and design and technical solutions makes it possible to provide a given resource for sliding contacts brush-slip ring. Electrodynamic processes, friction and wear processes to the greatest extent affect the operational reliability of the collector-slip ring assembly. Improving the design, the optimal choice of materials and the method of forming the surface layer are the main directions for ensuring a given resource of electrical machines. The latter is ensured by forming the optimal quality of the surfaces and material properties of the wear elements of the structure. To solve these problems, target functions and the structure of physical processes are formed. In addition, a relationship has been established between controlled and uncontrolled parameters. The defining parameters and response parameters are taken into account. This made it possible to formulate specifications for the design and development of a tool for finishing friction surfaces. The developed tool combines a combination of impact and friction processes on the surface being machined.

articleTitle: Digital Control System of a Pulsed Power Supply for the Plasmatron
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: The stages of designing a digital PI controller are outlined, which provides an exponential nature of the transient process at the maximum allowable amplitude of load current ripples in a quasi-steady state in the range of amplitudes of stepwise setting actions and a given switching frequency of the power switches of the converter. The MATLAB system with the Simulink extension was used as a working tool for analysis, synthesis and modeling. The results of modeling and experimental studies are presented.

articleTitle: Research on the Method of Improving Fuel Quality for Heat Generators
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: The purpose of the article is to address the issues of quality of analysis of electrophysical parameters of fuel using a system based on high-frequency radiators. The authors have proposed a system that is able to determine, control and automatically make decisions about the state of a physical object based on the study of the efficiency of disturbing oscillations in an open resonator. The article considers the change in the efficiency coefficient in the system under study when the distances between mirror reflectors are changed, taking into account the reflection coefficients. The dependence of the change in the Q-factor on the change in the distance between the mirrors for oscillations in an excited hemispherical open resonator is also considered. The analysis shows that improvement of the geometry of the open resonator chamber parameters can contribute to the quality of the analysis. The research carried out by the authors emphasises the capabilities of the system using high-frequency radiators for efficient measurement of electrophysical parameters of fuel and control over their changes. The generalisation of the research results may be of practical importance for the development of new methods for measuring and controlling the electrophysical parameters of fuel, which can be used in various industries such as energy, chemical industry and others.

articleTitle: The Development of the Theory of Energy Conversion Processes in a Complex System Electromechanical Assemblage
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: The theory of energy process analysis in electromechanical complexes received further development. Systematization of approaches to the decomposition of the time function of the instantaneous power of polyharmonic signals in various circuit solutions and modes has been carried out. The mechanism of formation of instantaneous power components of polyharmonic signals is considered. A mathematical apparatus for determining canonical, non-canonical and pseudo-canonical components of instantaneous power is proposed. The effect of strengthening the alternating-signal component of the power due to the coincidence of the frequencies of the canonical and pseudo-canonical components is proven. The possibility of expanding the complex of energy process assessments in the space of instantaneous power is shown.

articleTitle: Analysis of Magnetic Field Simulations of Magnetoelastic Sensors Quasi-Statically using COMSOL Multiphysics and MATLAB Software
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: This work describes a procedure in which a transient simulation of electromagnetic fields can be done when the electrical conductivity of the ferromagnetic medium can be effectively neglected transforming it into a quasi-static problem. A pressductor-type magnetoelastic sensor simulation model was created. The sensor’s output consists of a change of the induced voltage in the secondary coil due to applied compressive stress. Induced voltage is proportional to the time-derivative of the magnetic flux flowing through the coil and therefore is transient in nature. However, transient analyses tend to be computationally expensive and can yield noisy outputs when the model is not sufficiently densely discretized and appropriate tolerances are chosen. To overcome this, a quasi-stationary analysis of the same system is introduced and computed using the COMSOL Multiphysics FEM simulation software with further processing in the MATLAB environment, and the results are compared.

articleTitle: Technology of Creation Term Papers in Electrical Engineering Dicsiplines in the Online Learning Environment
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: In the article is presented the technology of creation term papers in electrical engineering in the online learning environment. The necessity of training electrical engineering specialists in modern conditions as well as acquisition the professional competencies during preparing term papers are outlined. The proposed technology consists of five stages: preparatory, analytical, calculation, modelling and discussion. The training in online learning environment for electrical engineers have some peculiarities that occurs due to the big amount of data, calculations and using special engineering programs. So, there is a need not only use the digital environment of the higher educational institution but the involve the use of third-party engineering programs. According to each stage of the proposed technology there is outlined some types of the soft that can be used. The result of this technology is the creation of term papers that allow students to gain competencies in those disciplines while earning points in the online learning environment. The obtained results were checked statistically that confirms the efficiency of creation term papers in electrical engineering in the online learning environment.

articleTitle: Energy Analysis of the Structures of the Controlled Drive of the Fuel Pump of a Vehicle Diesel Engine for Driving in Urban Conditions
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: The paper presents an energy analysis of the proposed controlled drives of the high-pressure fuel pump for diesel engines of vehicles designed for the operating conditions of cars and other vehicles at modern urban traffic intensity. It has been determined that diesel engines operate under such driving conditions mainly at low and medium crankshaft speeds and have higher fuel consumption than at nominal speeds. Diesel-electric generators are increasingly favored in transportation due to their distinct advantages over gasoline or gas alternatives. Diesel generators offer superior economy, reliability, and safety, demonstrating resilience under heavy loads and enabling prolonged operation over several days. They also exhibit relatively low fuel consumption and possess an extended operational lifespan. The article introduces and analyzes various design schemes for controlled drives of high-pressure fuel pumps in vehicle diesel engines, proposing an optimal solution. It is also proposed to use such drives of a diesel engine fuel pump together with a pressure pulse modulator. A theoretical study of the processes of fuel spraying, evaporation and burnout during the operation of fuel equipment equipped with a pressure pulse modulator and a controlled high-pressure fuel pump drive at different speeds of automotive diesel engines is carried out. The theory of calculating the area of efficient operation of such fuel systems is developed.

articleTitle: Currents and Magnetic Force in Magnetoimpulse Treatment of Aluminum Plates: Experimental Validation and Modeling Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: Application of high-density impulse currents, exceeding 10^9 A/m^2, is known to induce electroplastic effect in metal products. It investigates magnetopulse treatment by application of pulse electromagnetic field for localization current flow in welding joints of non-magnetic aluminum plates under coils of inductor. The aim of this study is to compare measured and calculated values of currents and voltages at terminals of the inductor in magnetopulse treatment of aluminum plates with varying thickness. Additionally, the study aims to determine impulse current density and force density in treatment area of these plates. An experimental prototype of the inductor, consisting of two coils and a P-shaped magnetic core, is developed and connected to the impulse current source with capacitor 2 mF and peak voltage 500 V. Numerical modeling using the finite element method is employed to calculate current density and force density in the aluminum plates. The modeling involves solving magnetic field equation and electric circuit equation for discrete time intervals to obtain transients. A comparison analysis made between measured and calculated values of impulse currents. It also investigates electromagnetic forces and impulse eddy currents in the aluminum plates with presence and absence of a magnetic core.

articleTitle: Obtaining an Alternative Source of Energy by Processing Atmospheric CO2 Into Liquid Fuel When Using a Cryptocurrency Miner with a Hybrid Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: This paper proposed to solving the actual problem of converting atmospheric CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> into fuel as an alternative source of electricity and increasing the commercial attractiveness of this process. This conceptual solution proposes combining a CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> to fuel converter powered by a solar panel with a cryptocurrency miner in one device. Such a solution makes possible obtaining a commercially attractive device for preventing the excessive content of atmospheric carbon dioxide. Commercial attractiveness is achieved by charging a limited internal token of the project to each user in proportion to the capacity of his equipment involved in the processing of carbon dioxide.

articleTitle: Electric Power Systems' Electromagnetic Compatibility
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: The article deals with the issue of determining the magnitude of disruptive voltage in the analyzed circuit, which is generated by the power device circuit, based on the electrical and geometric parameters of these circuits and simulation. The magnitude of this voltage can cause disturbances and errors in the device, which have become more significant due to the increasing complexity of electronic circuits. Therefore, according to technical legislation, it is necessary to strictly adhere to the concept of electromagnetic compatibility (EMC) for all products. This way of investigating EMC is the most cost-effective. The investigation focuses on four fundamental paths of energy transfer: galvanic, inductive, capacitive, and electromagnetic.

articleTitle: New Control Method for Multi-phase Buck DC-DC Converters Used with Photovoltaic Panels
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: The paper deals with a new algorithm for controlling a multi-phase buck DC-DC converter. The principle of its control is explained in detail using a flowchart. It is based on the continuous change of the converter topology using the number of its currently controlled phases depending on the size of the input power. In connection with this, its microprocessor control is also mentioned. The whole issue is explained on the design, simulation and measurement of a laboratory sample of a four-phase buck converter.

articleTitle: A Universal DSP Module for Simultaneous Multiple RS232 Communication with Synchronous Measurements Reading Capability
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: The paper provides detailed information about the design and implementation of the universal DSP module for simultaneous multiple RS232 communication with synchronous measurements reading capability. The hardware aspect of the module includes the development of an electric scheme and PCB scheme, ensuring the proper functioning and connectivity of the RS232 devices. Additionally, the paper includes relevant pictures that visually depict the module's design and components. Furthermore, the software part of the module is described, focusing on the development of an application that facilitates the reception and processing of data from the connected RS232 devices. The paper provides a comprehensive description of the created application, outlining its features and functionalities. Overall, this research offers a comprehensive exploration of the hardware and software aspects of the universal DSP module, providing readers with valuable insights into its design, implementation, and application in facilitating simultaneous RS232 communication with synchronous measurements reading capability.

articleTitle: Synthesis Analysis of Energy Intensity Dependence for Tandem Mills Thin-Plate Rolling on Various Grade Emulsols Rheological Properties
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: The basic rheological and physicochemical properties of rolling emulsions from different manufacturers and their influence on energy consumption during cold rolling of thin plate on tandem mills are considered. A generalized mathematical model of the influence of rheological and physicochemical properties on energy consumption during cold rolling of thin plates on four-, five- and six-stand quarto tandem mills has been compiled. The descending relation between the kinematic viscosity of the rolling emulsion and the specific energy consumption for tandem thin strip cold rolling mills is analytically calculated and shown. Theoretical graphic dependencies are constructed, showing the general trend of reducing the specific energy consumption for rolling for tandem mills with an increase in the viscosity of emulsols. An increase in the kinematic viscosity of the rolling emulsion by 10 m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>/s can reduce specific energy consumption at a four-stand mill by 0.07 kWh/t (0.82%), at a five-stand mill by 5.81 kWh/t (1.77%), and at a six-stand mill by 4.70 kWh/t (1.54%). Thus, a higher energy intensity of the five-stand mill was revealed in comparison with the four-stand and six-stand mill.

articleTitle: Using Sequential Observers to Estimate the Parameters and State Vector of the Control System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: The use of sequential observers to estimate the parameters and state vector of an uncertain system is considered. The task of the first observer is to estimate the state vector and the uncertainty vector. Based on the obtained uncertainty vector estimation, the second observer identifies external actions and parameter deviations. The proposed estimation method is designed for real-time operation. The availability of synthesized observers is confirmed by numerical simulation.

articleTitle: Circuit Simulation of Partial Discharges Arising in Neighboring Gaseous Cavities
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: Partial discharge is a critical phenomenon in high-voltage engineering, affecting the reliability and performance of electrical systems. Circuit simulation enables engineers to understand the electrical behavior of complex systems and study partial discharge events. The three-capacitance model, known as the ABC-model, is widely used in partial discharge research and education. It provides a simplified representation of partial discharge phenomena, making it accessible for engineers. The ABC-model serves as a diagnostic tool for assessing the health and condition of insulation systems, aiding in preventing degradation and enhancing system reliability. This paper explores the importance of the ABC-model for engineers and discusses its application in design optimization and risk assessment. Additionally, it addresses the limitation of the ABC-model in simulating paretial discharges in systems with multiple cavities or complex geometries. Modifications to the model are proposed to account for mutual influences between neighboring cavities. Circuit simulations using freeware program were performed to analyze partial discharge behavior in adjacent cavities. The results demonstrated that neighboring cavities can provide alternative paths for partial discharge propagation, leading to accelerated aging of insulation. The proposed modification of the ABC-model, accounting for the mutual influence of closely spaced cavities, showed changes in partial diasharge patterns compared to the independent cavity model.

articleTitle: 3D Filament Temperature Distribution in the Microwave Heating Process
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: In this study, the filament for 3D printing under microwave radiation in the waveguide was researched. The process under study was microwave heating. The wave equation and heat conducting equation was used as model. Besides them signal flow graph was added as research tool for accounting on defect in filament. The temperature distribution in the filament is proportional to microwave field distribution and depends on the position of the filament sample in the tract. Such a distribution repeats microwave field distribution in filaments which was simulated and verified in MathCad. There was suggested moving the filament from the center of the wide wall of waveguide to the position of quarter of waveguide width from narrow wall in order to exclude dependence of readings from phase of reflection coefficient leaving only dependence from modulus of reflection coefficient. This study contains simulation in COMSOL Multiphysics too. The results of the simulation in COMSOL are a visual representation of the electromagnetic and thermal fields and it is partially coincide with simulation in MathCad.

articleTitle: Design of a Multi-Storey Model of an Automated Garage House Based on ATmega2560 Microcontroller
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: This article describes in detail the implementation of an automated parking house model based on ATmega2560 microcontroller that enables simple and efficient parking of cars in precisely determined positions. Described model offers to user convenient parking of the car model. In addition to the automated parking system, the system provides several additional functions realized by displacement sensors and smoke sensors. One of the goals of this paper is to eliminate potentially dangerous situations and collisions during parking and thereby increase safety in this area. The garage house model is not designed solely for parking purposes but also as a practical teaching tool in the field of sensors and actuators. It is precisely in this area that students can expand their skills in designing and implementing programs that can enable all the functions of the garage house - temperature and smoke detection, precise positioning of the platform through stepper motors, display outputs, and more. At the same time, they will learn teamwork, where the functionality of the garage house is divided into multiple parts, and individual teams of students must collaborate to successfully solve and create a fully functional garage house software.

articleTitle: Mathematical Model of Changes in Energy Costs for Thermostabilization of the Substrate and Objects in a Biogas Reactor
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: The article is devoted issue determining electrical energy for process heat distribution in reactor during fermentation of organic raw materials. The mathematical model used in article makes it possible to fully investigate a dynamics of changes in temperature of a solid or liquid-like object that takes part in the heating process, as well as to determine the amount of electrical energy spent on thermal stabilization a certain volume of substance in the reactor, taking into account: initial temperature values objects, environment, mode of fermentation, speed of rotation of the stirrer and wind, mode of movement of the substrate and physico-chemical parameters of objects that take part in thermostabilization. In the article, mathematical modeling is carried out, the result of which is obtaining graphic dependences of temperature changes of the construction of the heating cable, insulation and spiral, the substrate and the rest of the objects involved in the stabilization of the fermentation temperature. The mathematical model and t obtained graphic dependences changes in temperature objects in bioreactor and the value of the spent electrical power for heating provide an opportunity for further development in the direction of the creation of energy-efficient systems for mixing and heating substrate in bioreactors of various volumes, the synthesis of automatic control systems these processes, which will increase the productivity of biogas production by reducing energy consumption.

articleTitle: Classification models of direct opinion holders in the space of stylometric and sentiment features of chat messages
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: Messaging platforms and online chat services offered by internet-based companies (such as transportation providers, taxi services, energy providers, etc.) serve as conventional channels for customers to communicate with service providers and provide valuable feedback. As research shows, the stylistic and sentimental behavior of opinion holders carries a lot of valuable information about the client and provides opportunities, in particular, to build a connection between his behavioral patterns and his preferences as a customer of the service. The authors propose classification models for the analysis of the direct thoughts of holders in the space of stylometric and sentimental features of chat messages. The study focuses on examining the characteristics of holders through the use of their writing styles and emotional components. Research has shown the existence of clearly defined segments in the space of the above-mentioned features, which made it possible to develop a classifier that effectively classifies new holders based on their writing styles, which allows for the personalization of services and optimization of interaction. Knowledge of stylometric and sentiment patterns in chat messages has practical applications in improving recommender systems, improving customer service experiences, and understanding communicative dynamics in chats. The obtained research results open up new opportunities for the further development of the field of natural language processing and sentiment analysis, and are also of practical importance for the development of recommender systems and improving the quality of customer service in the field of chat platforms.

articleTitle: The Case Study Method as the Means of Improving Engineering Students’ Critical Thinking Skills
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: The basic objective of the research presented argues for a case study approach to teaching critical thinking skills to engineering students. It has been proved that even in the settings of the distance-learning, the case study method fosters students’ critical thinking, improves their motivation and learning outcomes. These results are obtained only if a) the material responds to the current students’ interests and conditions them for pre-class inquisitive preparation and active emotional in-class participation, and b) the case study procedure is thoroughly thought out with each step clearly described. The target group of the research is fifty-two bachelor year students of S. Kuznets Kharkiv National University of Economics learning the same discipline. The study demonstrates that guided problematic classroom discussions facilitate a deeper understanding of complex engineering issues, encourage active engagement and participation, develop students’ ability to think independently and logically, as well as enhance their communication and teamwork skills. The research outcomes may be of significant value and can be applied by lecturers of other specialties and HEIs which dramatically lacked practical constituent in education earlier under conditions of quarantine and nowadays under martial law.

articleTitle: Technologies for Increasing the Energy Efficiency of Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: the purpose of the work is to determine the factors that affect the consumption of electrical energy for the mechanical operation of electric vehicles during movement. Highlighting the key factors that must be paid attention to when performing mathematical modeling, taking into account the features of electric transport, as well as a complete picture of the forces acting on it. Search for key tools and means to determine the most optimal route of movement from several proposed options. As a result of the work, the most optimal and modern standardized motion tachogram for energy consumption studies was determined. Tools for obtaining data on alternative routes from point A to point B and terrain topology are defined. The criteria for determining the optimal route sampling frequency are described. The degree of influence of the driver's driving style factor on energy consumption is determined. A research model is proposed, which serves to accumulate data from the internal sensors of the electric vehicle, while driving, using the CAN bus. The existing tools used for processing the accumulated array of data based on artificial intelligence and machine learning are described.

articleTitle: Open source solution for CNC milling machine monitoring and comparison with Matlab simulation in real time
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: This research paper focuses on the use of a thermal model of a CNC machine monitoring system that has been developed using open-source tools. By integrating these tools, predictive maintenance capabilities can be developed, leading to increased machine reliability. The methodology involves the implementation of a thermal model designed with Simulink software. The thermal model has been implemented into a developed monitoring system based on open-source tools, which allows access to real-time data of the CNC machine. The thermal model’s correctness has been verified with the machine operation using the data obtained from the CNC machine monitoring system. The use of open-source tools provides flexibility and adaptability in tailoring the thermal model to specific requirements and gaining key insights into the thermal behavior of the machine. The final section of the publication presents a comparison of simulated and measured outputs.

articleTitle: Calculation of the Optimum Parameters of Electrical Energy Storage and Generating Sources in Autonomous Local Electrical Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: The paper presents the issue of determining the most the optimal parameters for electrical energy storage and generating equipment in autonomous local electrical systems (ALES). The substantiation of the role of energy storage devices in the presence of renewable energy sources in autonomous local electrical systems with a stochastic mode of operation is given. The main provisions of the used model of electrical systems are given. The dependence of the parameters of the energy storage device depending on the composition of generating capacities has been studied. The implementation of the problem of determining the parameters of electric energy storage devices by the method of purposeful simulation is considered. The results of the multi-criteria choice of power and energy intensity of the electric energy storage are substantiated. A mathematical model has been developed for determining the optimal parameters of electric energy storage devices for autonomous local electrical systems using mixed integer programming with optimization and taking into account economic indicators. The main provisions of the model used are considered. The dependences of the parameters of electric energy storage devices on the composition of the generation of autonomous local electrical systems have been studied.

articleTitle: Comparison of Theoretical and Experimental Data of Energy Consumption on the Use of Electrothermomechanical System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: The purpose research presented in article is check adequacy mathematical model that allows for a dynamic analysis consumption of electrical energy for heating substrate in methane tank by an electrothermomechanical system by analyzing the deviations between the obtained experimental and mathematical data on changes in temperature substrate and amount of electrical energy for thermostabilization process. The working hypothesis research presented in the paper is as follows: by using the developed mathematical model in the course a dynamic analysis of consumption electrical energy for heating and simultaneous mixing of substances in methane tanks by an electrothermomechanical system, it is possible to achieve a high accuracy mathematical description of changes in processes that coincide with changes in values in real conditions. Its further use will ensure an increase in the energy efficiency of mixing and heating substances in reactors. One of the most important results of the conducted scientific research is the establishment of high convergence for the mathematical model considered in the work, which allows determining the electrical energy spent on heating substances, taking into account the dependence of the temperature changes of objects, namely, the electric heating cable, the structure of the methane tank and the electrothermomechanical system , as well as taking into account the automatic adjustment of the power of the heaters in the process of increasing the temperature above the permissible level. The importance of the results presented in the work is the establishment of deviations between the results experimental and theoretical research, the consumption of electrical energy for heating a substance in a 40-liter reactor using an electrothermomechanical system. The value of the deviation is 4.7%, which confirms the adequacy and high accuracy of the developed mathematical model.

articleTitle: Exploring the Role of Social Media Platforms in Fostering Collaborative Learning in Distance Education
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: This scientific article explores the role of social media platforms in fostering collaborative learning in distance education. It discusses the benefits of collaborative learning, examines social media platforms' features that support collaboration, and explores their impact on learning outcomes. The article addresses challenges and considerations in using social media for collaboration and provides practical implications for educators. Educators can create dynamic and interactive learning environments by leveraging social media platforms. The research contributes to advancing distance education practices, enabling effective collaboration and learning in online communities.

articleTitle: Formation of Digital Competence of Future Specialists in Electrical Engineering during Distance Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: The formation model of digital competence of future specialists in electrical engineering during distance learning of the computer technologies in the design of electromechanical systems, which is based on narrative-digital and resource-oriented approaches, was developed and experimentally tested. The concept of "digital competence of future specialists", the components of the professional training of future specialists in electrical engineering, has been specified. The didactic support of the educational discipline "Computer technologies in design" has been improved. The main areas of formation of structural components of digital competence were further developed and specified during distance learning. The developed digital narratives can be applied to improve the quality of digital educational and methodological content of distance courses on any platform for distance learning.

articleTitle: Application of Structural Identification for Synthesis of Motion Control System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: This paper deals with studying the possibilities of structural identification of dynamics models for the synthesis of motion control systems. The reduction of the dynamics model of the system for the stabilization of the aircraft’s altitude has been carried out. The comparative analysis of dynamic characteristics of output signals by the reduced model and experimental information are represented. The optimal synthesis of the system for the stabilization of the aircraft’s altitude based on the reduced model has been carried out. Research of the efficiency of the proposed procedure has been done.

articleTitle: Non-Destructive Diagnostics System for Defect Detection in Metal Parts of Powerful Generators Using Eddy Current Sensor
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: The eddy current method of control is analyzed and the possibility of its use for the identification of metals and alloys is substantiated. It is shown that this can be done by modernizing the eddy current radio engineering system with dynamic scanning of metal samples, which consists in the use of modern microcontrollers with high-precision ADC operation. The structural scheme of the modernized system is presented, some aspects of the processing of the received response signal are considered, which made it possible to highlight the information coefficients that would represent the metal or alloy as a generalized image. It is proposed to use the developed control system for the inverse problem - detection of defective zones on rolled metal sheets. The process of identifying the type of defect is carried out using the same methods as for spot samples of metals. The application of automation of the movement of the sensor during the control of rolled metal allows to identify metals and alloys in real time, to carry out express control, without human intervention in the identification process.

articleTitle: Numerical Modeling of a Temperature and Cooling Medium Distribution in a Three-Phase Induction Motor
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: In this article, the temperature and the cooling medium (i.e. air) distribution inside a three-phase induction motor has been studied based on numerical modeling. The numerical computational fluid dynamics and the thermal analysis within the induction motor has been used. Two cooling possibilities of the three-phase induction motor have been analyzed and compared.

articleTitle: Design of a Device for Determining I-V curve of a Photovoltaic Panel Using SiC Power Transistors
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: This study presents the design of a device aimed at accurately determining the parameters of a photovoltaic (PV) panel through the utilization of Silicon Carbide (SiC) power transistors. The incorporation of SiC power transistors into the device's design ensures improved efficiency, durability, and reliability during the parameter measurement process. The architectural layout and operational principles of the device are elaborated upon, emphasizing the integration of SiC power transistors to enable precise parameter determination of the PV panel. Furthermore, the potential applications and advantages of this device within the field of solar energy are discussed. The proposed design holds great potential for advancing photovoltaic panel parameter determination techniques, ultimately contributing to the development of more efficient and sustainable photovoltaic systems.

articleTitle: Influence of Carbon Reinforcement on Properties of Polylactic Acid Filament Used in Electrotechnical Products
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: This article is dedicated to the investigation of the influence of carbon reinforcement on the properties of polylactide filament used in electrical devices.The researchers conducted a series of experiments to study the impact of adding carbon reinforcement on the mechanical and electrical properties of polylactide filament. Strength tests were carried out with different concentrations of carbon reinforcement. The research results demonstrated that the addition of carbon reinforcement significantly improved the mechanical characteristics of the polylactide filament, particularly enhancing its strength and wear resistance.Overall, the findings of this article indicate the promising potential of using carbon reinforcement to enhance the properties of polylactide filament, especially for its application in electrical devices. These studies can contribute to the development of new materials with improved mechanical and electrical characteristics, finding broad applications across various technological fields.

articleTitle: Heating Station Automated Control System Based on a Small-Scale Model of a Laboratory Stand
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: The expediency of using multi-functional laboratory stands in the process of training specialists in the electromechanical profession is substantiated. The paper contains characteristics of the small-scale model of the "Teplopunkt" laboratory stand, on the basis of which it is possible to research the means of automation of heating systems with supply ventilation. The structure of the automated control and monitoring system of the "Teplopunkt" laboratory stand is given. A laboratory workshop based on a small-scale model is developed. Its implementation allows improving the effectiveness of practical training of specialists in the field of automation of thermal processes. The dynamic characteristics of the operation of the laboratory stand with the maintenance of a constant temperature of the heat-transfer agent based on the mathematical model are obtained.

articleTitle: Effective Methods to Control the Switched Reluctance Drive of Pumping and Compressor Equipment and Electric Transport
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: The switched reluctance drive (SRD) of a single-cylinder piston compressor of refrigeration machine, a centrifugal pump of hydraulic water supply system and electric transport is considered. Block diagrams of the SRD control algorithms in these systems have been developed by changing switching angles, regulating supply or phase voltage, and regulating phase current limit level. Simulation modeling of the SRD dynamic modes has been performed taking into account the periodic dependence of compressor load torque on rotor angle, the flow rate cyclic variation in water supply system and the traction motor torque of electric transport. The analysis of control algorithms that provides the maximum efficiency factor of the switched reluctance motor (SRM) in operating range of speed control and the requirements for traction motor characteristic formation, pumping and compressor unit performance regulation is carried out. Based on generalization of the results, the recommendations for choosing effective methods to control the SRM as part of variable load systems have been developed.

articleTitle: Application of Sliding Modes in Internal Subsystems of Electric Drive with a Parabolic Position Controller
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: A position controller with a parabolic characteristic realizes its advantages over a proportional controller only under the condition of high accuracy and speed of internal control loops. They are fully capable of providing relay controllers due to sliding modes of operation. In this study, the structure of the positioning system is substantiated, in which a derivative observer with discontinuous control is also used to implement high-frequency sliding modes in the speed and acceleration control loops. With appliance of the N–i switching method, designed for speed optimization, an example of the synthesis of control systems for both an electric drive and an observer is considered. A study of the transients of the electromechanical system has been carried out, its results confirm the effectiveness of the proposed structural implementation in combination with the applied optimization method.

articleTitle: Intelligent Operational Decision Support System for Sugar Factory Resource Efficiency
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: With the economic crisis that is looming over the world due to changes in the energy sector and a reduction in the supply of certain types of products, energy and resource efficiency issues are becoming more relevant for the food industry. Also important is the preservation of the environment and the implementation of Cleaner Production trends. Most enterprises follow the concept of Industry 4.0 and increase efficiency through the implementation of intelligent methods, in particular machine learning. The paper proposes a neural network model of sugar production. The model makes it possible to predict the main estimates of resource efficiency used to correct the technological modes of production by the operator-technologist. The structure of the operational decision support system has been developed and is used by personnel to model and predict changes in resource efficiency estimates and KPIs calculated on their basis. Its feature is the integration of methods for achieving resource efficiency, improving environmental performance and ensuring KPIs. To do this, at the initial stage, an analysis of the main flows that affect resource efficiency and an assessment of their importance was carried out. Ensuring Production Performance is confirmed by the simulation and the adequacy of the created neural network accuracy of more than 95%.

articleTitle: Dynamic Modeling and Simulation of a Switched Reluctance Drive in Electric Locomotive
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: The results of switched reluctance drive with linear load speed control. In order to investigate the operational behaviour as well as special operating states of the entire drive system, a simulation model has been developed with the program SIMPLORER. A structural diagram of the drive with an intermediate direct current link is proposed. The possibility of using a DC–DC converter with a two–circuit control system is considered. Transient responses plots and mechanical characteristics electric locomotive are given.

articleTitle: Everything is Just Beginning: ChatGPT in the Educational and Scientific Space of Ukrainian Universities
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: The article presents research on using artificial intelligence in education and science in Ukraine, using Berdyansk State Pedagogical University as an example. A survey of 135 teachers and 428 students was conducted regarding their experience with ChatGPT. The survey results showed that students are more inclined to use artificial intelligence than teachers. The research results confirm the potential of artificial intelligence to improve the quality of education and scientific research in Ukraine but also highlight the need for a cautious approach to its use, considering possible risks and costs.

articleTitle: Optimisation Problem of Bi-current System of Distribution Generation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: The paper analyses the main problems of the use of electric energy, taking into account the trends of the evolution of modern electric power systems. Arguments are given in favour of the intensive development of a distributed generation. The circuit of a bi-current system, which is the most promising variant for the distributed generation, is considered. An objective function of the optimization has been formed for it, which is represented by the dependence of the efficiency on the DC link voltage. The analysis of the calculations, based on a typical example of the parameters, has shown that the most optimal voltage values are 110 V and 220 V for the DC link. At these voltage values, the region of the maximum possible values for the efficiency is reached.

articleTitle: Improvement of the Control of the Hybrid Photovoltaic System with Storage Battery to Increase the Object’s Power Over the Consumption Limit from the Grid
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: The improvement of the control of the hybrid photovoltaic system with a storage battery to increase the power of objects over the limit on consumption from the grid is considered. The aim is to ensure the functioning of the system at the deviation of the load schedule from the calculated one and the generation of photovoltaic battery from the forecast value while maintaining the taken limit of the energy storage depth of discharge. The principle of the control has been improved by setting the value of the added power and forming the state of charge graph of the storage battery. The formation of the storage battery state of charge graph with the correction of the value of the added power according to the deviation of the state of charge from the calculated value with a given step of discreteness in time is proposed. The control algorithm has been changed with the introduction of additional limitations and the exclusion of correction at separate time intervals. Changes are taken into account in the 24-hour model of energy processes in the system. Also, the error of the storage battery state of charge estimation is taken into account. The simulation results confirm the possibility of providing the accepted depth of the discharge value for the calculated load schedule when photovoltaic battery generation is below the forecast value of up to 30%.

Author Keywords: forming of the state of charge graph
power correction by deviation of state of charge

articleTitle: Modelling Photovoltaic Cells under Variable Conditions of Temperature and Solar Insolation Intensity
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: Solar radiation, as well as the temperature of photovoltaic cells, influences the production of electrical energy from photovoltaic systems. Therefore, this contribution focuses on examining how these two operating parameters affect the operation of photovoltaic cells. Through simulation, it is possible to draw conclusions about the impact of temperature and solar radiation on the operation of photovoltaic cells.The first simulation was aimed at studying the influence of temperature on the production of electrical energy. We chose the I-V characteristic as an indicator. The second simulation focused on the impact of solar radiation on the operation of the photovoltaic cell. Each parameter affects a different aspect of the photovoltaic cell. However, both parameters significantly influence the power output of the photovoltaic panel and, therefore, the production of electrical energy.

articleTitle: Obtaining Electricity Through The Use of Biogas, Investments And Perspectives
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: Biomethane production has great potential for development in both the European Union and Ukraine due to the growing demand for renewable energy sources and the need to reduce greenhouse gas emissions. Biomethane is produced by the anaerobic digestion of organic matter, such as agricultural waste, sewage, and food waste. It can be injected into the existing natural gas grid and used as a fuel for heating, transportation, and electricity generation.

articleTitle: Electroceutical Devices in Wounded Skin Treatment
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: Smart wound healing is a term that refers to the use of advanced materials and technologies that can actively interact with the wound environment and promote tissue regeneration. Rapid changes in the physical, chemical and mechanical parameters of the affected skin may make visual assessment of the wound healing process insufficient. Sensors used in wearable electronics allow for a quick reaction of medical services to disturbing changes occurring within the wound area. This paper is a review of possible electroceutical solutions for monitoring and accelerating the healing process.

articleTitle: Investigation Principles Voltage and Frequency Optimal Control Princeples to Increase Energy Efficiency in Belt Conveyor Systems Under Artificial Load
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: The electromechanical system of continuous transport of an automated metalworking line using a system of frequency converter with asynchronous electric motor under artificial load is considered. The goal and the task of increasing the energy efficiency of the belt conveyor by using two options for building a control system for regulating voltage and frequency in continuous transport is formulated and confirmation the adequacy of studies carried out earlier on this topic through a numerical experiment are conducted. The first variant provides the leading channel of voltage regulation, while the second variant gives priority to frequency regulation with voltage subordination. The study also examines the impact of fixed and flexible conveyor load conditions on the efficiency of using energy-efficient voltage and frequency regulators. The obtained results show that the fixed load minimizes the energy loss on remagnetization, but is generally less efficient. Flexible load adjustment requires additional losses for partial remagnetization, but during the technological cycle provides a higher level of energy efficiency. Formulated conditions for the use of research results in industry.

articleTitle: Digitalization as a Catalyst for Smart Grid Development in Ukraine: Status and Prospects of Implementation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: The digitalization of Ukraine's energy sector has the potential to transform the country's power grid into a smarter, more efficient system. With the help of advanced technologies and digital solutions, the implementation of a smart grid can enhance the reliability and security of the energy supply while reducing costs and environmental impact. Despite the challenges and obstacles that may arise during the implementation process, the prospects of a fully digitalized energy system in Ukraine are promising. It is emphasized in the paper that digitalization makes it possible to balance electricity consumption by returning excess power to the same network from which it was transmitted. This is especially relevant for Ukraine from the standpoint of how to protect the power system during the war, considering the constant shelling of critical infrastructure and solving the issue of power outages. The government, energy regulators, and private sector stakeholders must work together to ensure the successful deployment of smart grid technologies, which will ultimately benefit both the energy sector and the country as a whole.

articleTitle: Identification of Online Social Media Bots Based on Classification Models
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: Text messages from customers, which are commonly exchanged through Internet services (in particular, transport companies, taxi services, energy generating companies etc.) such as messengers and chats, serve as conventional communication tools between customers and service providers. They also serve as a valuable source of operational data, containing crucial information about customer preferences, as well as opinions regardig specific aspects of the service and its quality.At the same time, among a number of problems that arise in this case, there is the influence of bots. Identification of bots and the content generated by them is an urgent task.The authors build and investigate a number of classification models on the example of Twitter content. It is shown that the model based on random forests provides the best results for bot identification.

articleTitle: Software Modeling of Measuring the Influence of Infrasound as a Production and Environmental Factor of Industry Technologies on the Membrane Complex of Microorganisms of Technological Processes
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: The mathematical model of cell membrane resonance in the three-dimensional Cartesian coordinate system with mechanical load is considered. The method of determining the resonant frequency of the membrane of a microorganism cell using such parameters as thickness, surface tension and density of the membrane has been improved, which allows for a suppressive effect on living organisms. Software for determining the resonance frequency of the cytoplasmic membrane of microorganisms is proposed. The proposed mathematical model allows you to calculate the resonance frequency of the cell membrane of a microorganism, which can be used in epidemiological institutions to neutralize or suppress various types of microorganisms.

articleTitle: Speed Control Algorithms of Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor in Sliding Mode
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: This paper examines speed control algorithms for permanent magnet synchronous motor operating in a sliding mode, which ensure first, second, and third-order astatism. The control algorithms are developed based on the reversibility of the direct Lyapunov method for stability analysis. The closed-loop control system has a predefined Lyapunov function, represented by the instantaneous energy value. The control system consists of two current regulators and a speed regulator, all operating in a sliding mode. The investigation of the control algorithms demonstrated high control quality and a straightforward synthesis procedure. A distinctive feature of these control algorithms is the absence of parameters synchronous motor and differentiation operations, which facilitates their practical implementation.

articleTitle: Influence of Welding Current and Electric Butt-Welding of Strip Conditions on the U-Channel Section Strength After Roll-Forming
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: At research of influence of connection conditions for strip blank with thickness from 1.0 mm to 1.35 mm by electric butt-welding on the tensile strength (Y<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">b</inf>), the strength index (P) and percentage elongation (δ%) of the formed U-channel section in its flanges and in the web after multi-pass cold roll-forming experimentally varied of voltage in a secondary circuit of a weld coil from 2.7 V to 3.6 V were conducted. After tensile tests, data were obtained characterizing the dependence of the strength characteristics of the section on the thickness of the blank material at stable welding current modes of the butt-welding machine. It was found that the strength properties are distributed unevenly along the cross-section (length of the cross-weld seam), which is associated with unsatisfactory clamping of the strip ends during butt-welding in the mode of switching off (reducing) the welding current. The identified cases of decreased strength characteristics of the open section in one of the flanges and in the web should be unambiguously attributed to the influence of the initial non-parallelism of the ends of the strips to be welded. The welding current mode U = 2.7 V for a strip thickness of 1.0 mm showed the best results.

articleTitle: Developing Non-Technical Skills of Electrical Engineers in Paradigm of New Industrial Relations
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: Development of communication skills and other non-technical skills of electrical engineers, in whose professional activity communication processes and social interactions occupy an important place, is one of actual pedagogical problems in engineering education. Subjective (individual) factors for the development of electrical engineers’ non-technical skills are the level of development their communication skills and social skills. Objective factors include conflict professional communications that may be resolved by communication skills. A model of the gradual development of electrical engineers’ non-technical skills has been designed. According to the principle of a systemic approach (the development of a general methodology for study of fact or phenomenon), a selection of methods was carried out, with the help of which electrical engineer’s non-technical skills were considered simultaneously as a complete object of research and as a set of interconnected and interdependent elements (indicators). A table of two group methods for nontechnical skills diagnosis has been designed.

articleTitle: Analysis and Prospects of Using Ultrafine-Grain Copper for Highly Loaded Cable Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: This scientific article delves into the analysis and prospects of utilizing ultrafine-grain copper for highly loaded cable systems. The potential applications of new ultra-fine-grained and nanostructured metal conductors in various fields, such as heavily loaded cable systems, windings of motors and generators, low-current computer networks, and devices operating under challenging conditions were explored. The article presents detailed analyses of the mechanical and electrical properties of ultrafine-grained copper and copper alloys. The influence of several plastic deformation on these properties is explored, and the results demonstrate a significant increase in the strength characteristics of the materials due to nanostructuring. However, the electrical conductivity of ultrafine-grained metals, including copper, is a complex phenomenon and depends on various factors, such as defects accumulated at grain boundaries. The research includes theoretical approaches, such as percolation models, to study and understand the electrical conductivity of ultrafine-grained copper. The obtained results revealed the evolution of the structure during intense deformation, showing a decrease in the size of the coherent scattering region and the presence of microstrains in the ultrafine-grained copper structure. These structural changes significantly impact the mechanical and electrical properties of the material, making it important to comprehend and optimize the applications of ultrafine-grained copper in electrical and energy systems.

articleTitle: Study of Electric Drive Control System Speed-Optimized with Prediction of Jerk Value
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: Performance optimization is based on motion prediction. This goal is met by systems with constraints on internal coordinates. However, the jerk does not belong to the stabilized values in most structures of electric drives. In this study, a method for predicting the equivalent constant jerk for voltage stabilization intervals of a power converter is considered. With its use, an electric drive control system was synthesized by the N–i switching method, designed for speed optimization. The simulation of the transient characteristics of the system under the conditions of varying its settings and parameters of the control object has been performed. The results of the study testify to the effectiveness of the proposed optimization algorithm and indicate ways for further improvement of systems synthesized using it.

articleTitle: Decision-Making for Remote Control of Emergency Mobile Robot
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: The proposed paper analyses the decision-making for remote control of emergency mobile robotic platforms. There is described a model of robot’s decision-making, based on predicate logics, which combines local and remote procedures of goals and actions determination. The developed model uses the description of local emergency workspace added with remote-supplied information, based on distributed computer vision system. In core of decision-making system is problem-solving engine, which includes the set of action procedures, goals, specifications of robot and its sensor system. The procedure of action typically contains the result of action, the set of subgoals to solve, set of added facts and removed facts on workspace. Facts of considered workspace includes the descriptions of objects inside workspace with their coordinates, dimensions, and probable identification. To describe the emergency workspace here is proposed information model, based on set theory descriptions. While emergency robot is mostly considered as autonomous system with independent decision-making, the role of remote control is still essential for fast recognition of unknown or damaged objects, fast generation of movements and actions in emergency workspace, fast solution on actions in dangerous situations, for fast information support from other robots and people. The key role of remote control system can be executed by human operator with help of intelligent tools of other remote control systems, which provide monitoring of emergency workspace, based on computer-vision of acting robot and other information sources. The proposed ideas can be considered as a basis for real emergency robot control system implementation.

articleTitle: Mobile Application for Visualizing the Measurements
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: This paper deals with the design of an Android mobile application and visualization of the measured values of particulate matter and meteorological factors from the measurement stations. The application can in principle be effectively used in any field of data visualization. The architecture of the mobile application, the security, the use of AWS services to access the data in the InfluxDB databases, as well as the user interface and graphical visualizations of the measured data are described and illustrated. The application is user tested and the paper documents their first experiences using the mobile application.

articleTitle: Optimization Study of the Process of Manufacturing The Components of the Thermal System of an Electric Car
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: The problem of operating electric cars is the heating of batteries during their discharge and charge. Moreover, in the cold season, the battery pack must be heated to increase the range and reduce the charging time, in the warm season, on the contrary, to cool. That's what the car's heating system is for. One of the components of the thermal system are metal plates with stiffeners. As a method of manufacturing such plates, profiling with a pair of forming rollers is used. It is shown that for the high-quality production of such elements of the system, it is necessary to accurately determine the stress field at the radius of curvature of the deformable workpiece. Analytical dependences are obtained, which allow calculating meridional stresses and controlling their magnitude by technological parameters.

articleTitle: Algorithm for Hierarchical Evaluation of the Entity of Direct Opinion in the Task of Sentiment Analysis of Complicated Text Content From Social Media
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: Internet messengers and chat platforms, including those utilized by transport companies, taxi services, energy providers, and similar entities, have long been established as customary channels for customers to interact with service providers and provide feedback.In this context, the main task is the analysis of the semantic and sentiment components of the textual content produced in them. A feature of chat messages is a relatively small number of words, the use of jargon and specific symbols, emojis, etc., which creates a serious problem for extracting the semantic component for both humans and artificial intelligence. The authors call such a text complicated.The authors propose an algorithm for evaluating the entity, which is the subject of discussion in a chat message, and their features, based on the use of dependency parsing. Its quality is assessed on real data, where both humans and artificial intelligence based on a generative model act as experts.Implementing such an approach, specifically through the utilization of AI-powered chatbots or managers, will enhance the quality of service experienced by customers of power generating companies and similar services.

articleTitle: On-Line Monitoring Of Sensors
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: The article considers the short results of the fulfilled research and implemented requirements in the field of on-line monitoring of sensors (OLM) at the Ukrainian nuclear power plants (NPP). OLM is a system of planned (periodic) monitoring of the technical characteristics of sensors at the installation location (without their dismantling) during the launch, shutdown, and operation of the NPP power unit. During OLM within the surveillance system an assessment, monitoring, and control of the condition of the sensor is performed depending on the influence of certain factors. The results of OLM are used to justify decisions regarding the further calibration of sensors.The main requirements of industrial standard SOU NAEK 234:2021 "Engineering, scientific and technical support. Requirements for procedures for monitoring the condition of pressure sensors at NPPs" developed by specialists of the State Scientific and Technical Center for Nuclear and Radiation Safety (Ukraine) are described in the article. Namely, the purpose and tasks of OLM, the conditions for conducting OLM, and the main stages of OLM for the stationary mode of operation of the NPP power unit and OLM after the launch or shutdown of the NPP power unit are considered. An example of OLM analysis results and the advantages of using of OLM are also presented.

articleTitle: Increasing the Efficiency of Solar Power Plants Based on the Use of Voltage Booster Transformers
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
