abstract: The paper provides an assessment of the state of solar energy and its prospects based on the example of Ukraine. The relevance of the work is determined, due to the great potential of Ukraine in the field of alternative energy, especially solar, on the one hand, and their insufficient efficiency, on the other, Ukraine has all the prerequisites for the further successful development of the solar energy market and reaching the highest indicators in Europe: the highest DNL (direct normal light), high "green" tariff, etc. But, unfortunately, this development is restrained by the lack of effective systems for their management, especially in the conditions of compatible operation with the power system. This work is devoted to the consideration of these issues.

articleTitle: Vector and neural network control of asynchronous electric drive with friction load
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: The results of asynchronous electric drive with nonlinear friction load speed control studies in systems based on classical vector and intelligent scalar control are presented. To obtain the results, the induction motor block diagram and electric drive with vector control system based on subordinate coordinate control and intelligent scalar control system with neurocontroller simulation models are developed. The neurocontroller is based on a multilayer feed-forward neural network of the «perceptron» type obtained by genetic algorithm training (diploid scheme). A comparative analysis of the studied control systems operation under the condition of dynamic self- oscillating modes has been carried out. Transient responses plots and mechanical characteristics of asynchronous electric drive in the studied control systems with nonlinear friction load are given. The feasibility of using scalar intelligent control for asynchronous electric drive with nonlinear friction is shown.

articleTitle: Smart Plant Monitoring and Controlling System for Greenhouse Application Using IoT
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: This work provides an IoT-based plant monitoring system for avoiding over-exploitation of resources, ensuring compact design with easy installation and the best environment for the plants to grow. This type of agricultural monitoring system provides environmental monitoring services that help the crop grow in good shape. The system offers the service of storing a database about the environment and soil information acquired from a wireless sensor network deployed in the planted area. Furthermore, it enables users to track environmental data regarding planted crops in real-time using any Internet-enabled device. Our project introduces automatic sunlight prevention and soil moisture control based on data received from the moisture and temperature sensors. The proposed work is implemented using a microcontroller, programmed accordingly to measure the temperature and moisture using respective sensors. It is well capable of controlling temperature by operating a fan, controlling a shade for blocking excess sunlight and controlling moisture by operating a watering device through a motor. The potential outcome of the project work can be used for greenhouse monitoring and controlling systems.

articleTitle: Stability Analysis of the 2nd Order Piecewise Linear Interval Dynamic Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: The paper deals with the development of a theoretical backgrounds to study stability of the generalized second order dynamical system. These backgrounds are based on the use of interval methods to define piecewise linear boundaries for system nonlinearities. Defined in such a way boundaries depend on system state variables and allows us to transform any nonlinear system into interval system with quadratic and/or linear terms, which values are defined as values of secant and tangent lines to the nonlinear function. Such approach allows us to consider both intervals of concavity and convex of initial nonlinear functions. The upper and lower boundaries for the considered nonlinearity are defined as maximal and minimal values of secant and tangent piecewise linear functions. One can use parameters of the above-mentioned piecewise linear boundaries to rewrite initial nonlinear system into interval form. Since the system boundaries are defined to always constrain any system motions, we can use them to perform stability analysis. We use system phase plane to perform system dynamic study. This study allows us to formulate several statements about system stability and instability. Moreover, due to the necessarily to consider motions in lower and upper boundaries, the semi-stability phenomenon of interval system is found. One can find this phenomenon occurring in the system with one stable and one instable boundaries. We show analogy between our approach and the first Lyapunov methods and use it to specify the last one.

articleTitle: Analysis of the photoluminescence degradation of porous silicon layers
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: In this paper, we present methods for the preparation of phosphorylated porous silicon structures that do not degrade in air over time. The best results that meet the purpose of this work were obtained on a PS sample prepared in an electrochemical solution with the addition of HCl. The addition of HCl to the standard electrolyte promotes the formation of stoichiometric SiO2 oxide on the PSi surface. The addition of FeCl3 to the electrolyte leads to the formation of a stable iron compound on the PSi surface, which stabilizes its photoluminescent properties. Low-temperature annealing of the sample also leads to stabilization of the PSi’s PL properties, but the main disadvantage of this method is the formation of nonelemental silica SiOx on the PS surface, which leads to the quenching of the PL of PSi.

articleTitle: Research of Electromagnetic and Electromechanical Processes in High-Voltage Soft Start Devices with Gate Turn-Off Thyristors
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: The purpose of the work is to investigate the possibilities of soft-start devices with gate turn-off thyristors in electric drives of bow thrusters with adjustable propeller pitch to increase reliability, reduce mechanical shocks and currents, and improve electromagnetic compatibility with the ship’s electrical power plant. The characteristic features of these drives are operation on fan load and the need for a smooth start in a sufficiently short time to reduce impact torque in the mechanism. As a result of the analysis, a solution with a shunt capacitor is proposed, which provides high accuracy of regulation of the 1st harmonic of the voltage on the motor according to the given law. The minimum value of the capacitor capacity was found, which for the ABB/AMD710L8T motor with a capacity of 2.7 MW is 150-250 μF at switching frequencies from 500 to 1000 Hz. For the first time, the dependences of the GTO switching frequency on the capacitor capacity and the coefficient of harmonic distortion of the current in the stator phase of the selected motor were found. Frequencies are obtained that correspond to the actual physical characteristics of the GTO (500–1000 Hz). At such switching frequencies, the characteristics of the soft start device practically do not differ from the ideal regulator of the phase voltage of an asynchronous motor. This makes it possible to synthesize closed systems with stabilization of the main coordinates of soft starter electric drive, two-circuit systems with the formation of a given tachogram with torque limitation. All this makes it feasible to implement soft start devices based on gate turn-off thyristors.

articleTitle: Energy System with Solid Oxide Fuel Cells and Steam-Injected Gas Turbine
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: A power system scheme with solid oxide fuel cells and steam-injected gas turbine with overexpansion has been proposed. A mathematical model of the hybrid solid oxide fuel cell–gas turbine (SOFC-GT) system has been developed, allowing for the optimization of the thermodynamic parameters of its gas turbine component. Optimization calculations of the power plant efficiency with a capacity of 2500 kW have been performed. The obtained results have determined directions for the creation of promising energy systems with fuel cells and gas turbines, expanding the understanding of the processes that govern energy conversion.

articleTitle: Recommendations Concerning the Renovation Ukraine Electric Power Structure
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: the paper is devoted to the analysis of the condition of the Electric Power Supply Systems (PSS) of Ukraine, in particular ones located on the Luhansk Region territory. The main idea «transition to the European system standards» is proposed in focus of connectivity improvement and quality improvement of the Power Supply. A brief description of the state of the Power Supply Systems for the Luhansk Region according to the data of the "Luhansk Energy Association" LLC before the start of full-scale military invasion of the Russian Federation, is provided.The article deals with the lack of design solutions for the reconstruction of Overhead Power Lines 10 kV and village-type Transformer Substations by voltage 20 kV, as well as design solutions for the new construction of 20 kV village-types Transformer Substations. It is noted there will be additional outlays for of Electrical Networks Companies for switchover not only their own Electrical Installations 10 kV to 20 kV voltage, but also Electrical Installations owned by users. The article uses a methodology of comparative analysis the cost-effectiveness and efficiency of the transition to a higher voltage 20 kV.Decreasing the numbers of links in the Power System leads to a technological losses reduction. As well, the technological losses of Transformers depend on not only the load of users connected to them, but on the Transformers downtime in no-load operation also.

articleTitle: Analysis of Needs and Expectations in Business Education of Engineering Students
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: The article is devoted to the analysis of local features, needs and expectations in modern methods of business education of students of engineering and other specialties. Significant needs for business education of students of both economic and engineering specialties have been identified. The analysis of students' needs and expectations was based on a survey of 2,294 students from Ukraine and Azerbaijan during February-May 2023. Educational activities on business education are planned to be implemented within the ERAZMUS+ project regarding the implementation of a network of international virtual youth business centers in Ukraine, Azerbaijan and other countries, which is implemented by the Kyiv National University of Technology and Design and promotes the creation of an international network of youth virtual business hubs for students of universities, technical schools and schools. Most students have a need for business education programs, both synchronous and asynchronous. Based on participation in international youth virtual mobility programs, students want to develop and improve their communication skills: the level of foreign language proficiency, communicate with foreign peers, including through international virtual hubs. Students also want to develop business competencies, skills to create their own business, skills to create and implement startups.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Energy Processes in Smart Monitoring Systems of Local Electricity Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: Local electricity systems offer new features and opportunities for electricity suppliers and consumers. Transactive energy is a new concept that uses information exchange as a mechanism to better manage the local electricity system energy flow. Smart monitoring systems for transactive systems require monitoring of basic parameters such as voltage, frequency, and power. Energy characteristics make it possible to assess the impact of uneven consumption and generation of electricity, the quality of electricity, and the level of reactive power and network losses. The evaluation of energy processes is studied in this article. An algorithm for evaluating energy processes has been developed. Its operation in a system consisting of uninterruptible power sources (diesel generators) has been studied. Fuel consumption, which depends on the load, is the main feature of such systems. The ratios of load energy and fuel consumption were obtained, and the intervals that are optimal for the system under consideration with the corresponding load profile were selected by evaluating the energy processes.

articleTitle: Axial and Radial Induction Motors Comparative Characteristics Analysis to Assess Them Use Effectiveness
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: Recently, along with induction motors of traditional cylindrical design began to increase attention to induction mechanical motors, which outwardly also cylindrical, but the active sides of the stator and rotor windings are located in them in the radial direction, and not in the axial, as in conventional induction machines. Such a constructive scheme, as it turns out, has a number of undoubted advantages. First of all, the magnetic system in such engines is made of a strip with subsequent milling along one of the ends of the radial package. Grooves, which significantly reduces steel waste. In addition, the length of the frontal parts is reduced stator windings, and consequently, is reduced copper consumption. Above this, the end structure engine allows you to simplify the layout of the engine and mechanism. So, induction end motors have a slightly larger efficiency, better use of active materials and turn out to be more compact. The article discusses a comparative analysis of induction motors of axial and axial design, which are designed for traction of electric vehicles.

articleTitle: Design of Magnetic Field Sensors Spatial Arrangement for Overhead Power Lines Magnetic Field Active Cleanliness Single-Circuit System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: The work presents magnetometer placement design for air power line group active magnetically quiet system in one-story residential building. Magnetometer spatial placement and angular position calculated minimax optimization problem based. Optimization problem objective function calculated Biot-Savart’s law based. Problem solution calculated heuristic nonlinear Archimedes algorithm based. Computer and experimental study results of optimal magnetometer placement design for air power line group active magnetically quiet system in one-story residential building are given.

articleTitle: Changing the Surface Morphology of a Silicon Wafer to Improve the Efficiency of Solar Cells
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: In the presented work, the authors considered the issue of increasing the efficiency of solar cells based on single-crystal silicon. The authors see the solution to the problem in modifying the surface morphology of the rear side of the solar cell by creating a porous layer. In the work, a porous layer was created by electrochemical etching of a plate with a fixed current density of 40 mA/cm^2, and by changing the anodization time from 5 to 20 sec. in 5 sec increments for different samples. As a result, 4 samples of plates with a porous layer were obtained, the thickness of which was determined by the etching time and amounted to 20, 40, 60 and 80 mm, respectively. Measurement of the reflection coefficient of the plates with the deposited porous layer were measured in the range of light emission in the range of 300..1000 nm. The results obtained show that an increase in the thickness of the porous film leads to a decrease in the reflection coefficient by 25% for a plate with a porous layer thickness of 80 mm. This effect leads to a significant scattering of the reflected light from the rear surface of the plate and, consequently, to an increase in the length of the light path inside the plate. The evaluation of the increase in the efficiency of the SC operation was carried out by measuring the current-voltage characteristics and comparing with the current-voltage characteristics of the SC, the morphology of the back side of which was not changed. As a result, it was found that the creation of a porous layer leads to a slight change in the open-circuit voltage of the SC, by less than 10%, but at the same time it allows to increase the short-circuit current by more than 4 times. Thus, we can conclude that the modification of the surface morphology of a silicon wafer by creating a porous layer on it leads to an increase in the efficiency of solar energy conversion.

articleTitle: Determination of the Mechanical Characteristics of Two-Layer Electric Contacts Obtained by Explosion Welding
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: The use of multilayer electrical contacts opens up great opportunities for increasing the mechanical and corrosion resistance of the bearing parts and assemblies. The article presents the results of experimental data on the stretching of a two-layer composition of copper and aluminum. Relationship equations for plasticity with relative elongation and thermal loading modes are obtained. The best conditions for heat treatment of a multilayer structure are determined from the point of view of further shaping by sheet stamping methods. The adequacy of the incomplete square model was tested using the Fisher test. The significance of the regression coefficients was assessed using Student's t-test. The reproducibility of the process was compared with the Cochran test.

articleTitle: Six-Phase Galvanically Isolated Control Pulse Generator with Power Transistor Gate Connectivity Capability
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: This paper presents the development of a six-phase galvanically isolated control pulse generator with the capability to connect to power transistor gates. The design aims to provide efficient and reliable control signals for power transistors, ensuring effective power management in various applications. The pulse generator utilizes galvanic isolation techniques to prevent unwanted interference and ensure safe operation. The six-phase configuration enables precise control and synchronization of multiple power transistors, facilitating enhanced power distribution and load management. The connectivity capability to power transistor gates allows for seamless integration and control within power electronic systems. The proposed pulse generator design holds significant promise for optimizing power transistor operation, enhancing overall system efficiency, and enabling advanced power management in a wide range of applications.

articleTitle: Research of Control Methods of a Spherical Parallel Mechanism Using Intelligent Data Processing
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: The work is devoted to the research and development of a software and hardware platform based on control methods of a spherical parallel mechanism (SPM) with tracking of changes in the position of a human head with the help of a camera and a computer using intelligent data processing.This article explores the relevance and advantages of SPMs, emphasizing their high precision, enhanced mobility, reliability, and lightweight design. The paper deals with an important aspect of controlling SPMs, which directly influences their performance. The control methods for SPMs vary based on the specific tasks and operational requirements, such as actuator-based control, sensor-based control, closed-loop control, and adaptive control are presented.The research additionally investigates the problems of forming tasks for SPMs and the need for improved methods, especially for applications involving human-robot interaction, dangerous works, and camera positioning tasks. To resolve these problems, the study proposed a software-hardware platform that remotely controls SPMs by tracking changes in the position of the human head using a camera and a computer. By employing OpenCV and Dilb libraries for face recognition and control point tracking, the proposed platform enables intuitive and clear control of the mechanism.The article presents the mathematical operations involved in calculating the rotation angles of the SPM based on the tracked human head movements. The obtained rotation angles serve as inputs for the servomotors, allowing precise control over the mechanism's movements.The results of the study demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed software-hardware platform in controlling the SPM based on human head movements. The platform's ability to accurately track and convert head movements into servo rotation values enables remote and intuitive control of the SPM, making it a promising direction for future research in the field of robotics and automation.

articleTitle: Electrocapacitive Air Gap Sensor With Parallel Coplanar Electrodes for Hydrogenerators Condition Monitoring Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: In this paper proposed and investigated a capacitive sensor with parallel coplanar electrodes systems for measuring the air gap between the stator core bore and the rotor poles in a powerful hydroelectric generator. Air gap control is one of the key elements in condition monitoring hydrogenerators. Air gap sensor consists of a system of strip parallel coplanar high-potential and low-potential electrodes of equal width, between which grounded electrodes are placed. The electrodes that formed on a dielectric substrate. To reduce the impact of edge effects on the short sides of the high-potential electrodes, the length of the low-potential electrodes is chosen to be smaller than the length of the high-potential electrodes by an amount. The electrical capacity between the system of parallel-connected high-potential electrodes and the system of parallel-connected low-potential electrodes, which functionally depends on the size of the air gap, is measured. The conversion function of the sensor was determined analytically and with the help of crankcase modeling. A sample of the sensor intended for use on a capsule hydroelectric generator type SGK538/160-70M was obtained. Compared to analogues, the sensor has a higher measurement accuracy. A sensor or a system of sensors as part of a component for condition monitoring and diagnostic systems.

articleTitle: Improvement and Optimization of Automated Logistics Processes in Logistics Premises
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: This work is devoted to the actual topic of the analytical hierarchy method based on the principles of decomposition and synthesis, the implementation of which makes it possible to reduce the number of possible errors in the process of obtaining information from an expert. As a result of the analysis and its implementation be considered and calculated priority vectors for prestige, cost, specific fuel consumption, comfort, reliability, maximum speed, dimensions, maintenance costs, and warranty obligations. Global priorities are calculated at hierarchical synthesis. As a practical realization of the proposed method was created web-software for car choosing.

articleTitle: Monitoring System Development for Equipment Upgrade for IIoT
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: This paper presents a monitoring system development. This system is designed to upgrade existing production equipment in order to implement IIoT and CPPS approaches and to use all the advantages of these approaches. Authors constructed proposed monitoring system using ESP32-CAM and Arduino Uno. For the testing one analog-digital sound sensor KY-037, one water level sensor, and two temperature and humidity sensors DHT11 were used. Then there was developed hardware and software that allowed to obtain desired results of getting data from sensors and processing them in necessary way. Experimental results showed a possibility of using such a system for existing production equipment upgrade.

articleTitle: Apparent Power and Energy Characteristics of a Multiphase Power Supply System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: Increasing the power factor is one of the most important tasks of active filtering. For its successful solution, it is necessary to correctly determine the multiphase power supply system’s apparent power and active current. This paper considers a generalized case of a multiphase power supply system with different values of transmission line resistances, periodic currents and voltages of arbitrary shape. Using Schwartz’s integral inequality, applied in the reduced coordinate basis, the formulas of the apparent power and the corresponding active current in the matrix-vector form were obtained. The interdependence of the current and voltage multipliers of the apparent power formula on the transmission line resistance ratio is shown. When using energy-saving active filtering, the formulas for the minimum power loss and efficiency of a multiphase power supply system were derived. The obtained apparent power formula was compared with that given in IEEE Std. 1459-2010 for a three-phase, four-wire power supply system and the area of transmission line parameters for their convergence was established.

articleTitle: Ways to Optimise Losses in High Voltage Lines and its Optimization
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: In this paper, we classify technical losses based on their types. We examine and analyze existing methods for calculating conditionally-constant and loaded losses in electrical transmission air lines with a common function. To minimize relative energy losses, we propose a new objective function, which allows for optimizing total comparative electrical energy. By adopting this approach, we can determine the current minimum losses in the transmission lines.To encourage consumers and supply companies to implement optimal planning and energy-saving measures, we recommend adopting a standard technique for electrical energy loss based on relative losses relevant to the current scenario. Additionally, we conduct a factor analysis to study the variations in relative energy losses concerning different parameters and technical characteristics of the given transmission line. This analysis helps gain a deeper understanding of how these factors influence energy losses in the system.

articleTitle: Improving the Energy Efficiency of Small Hydropower Plants by Connecting an Energy Saving System with Kinetic Energy Storage
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: The potential and prospects for the development of small hydropower in Ukraine are analyzed. A method of increasing the energy efficiency of a small hydroelectric power plant while ensuring coverage of the consumer load is proposed and substantiated. The choice of an energy storage system based on kinetic storage devices is substantiated. The structure of the "small hydropower plant-energy storage system – consumer" system was developed and the energy efficiency of its operation was proven on the basis of mathematical modeling. The possible configurations of the system for various operating modes have been compiled, which also ensures an increase in energy efficiency due to the optimization of its architecture.

articleTitle: Study of the Bending Process for Conductive Electric Busbars
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: Conductive electric busbars are shipped and transported in the form of straight metal strips of various thicknesses and widths. But, while designing and assembling the power equipment, it is often required to carry out fitting work, aimed at busbar bending and perforating. The article presents the theoretical analysis results of the bending process for a finite-size strip, with determining the analytical expressions for the bending moment of the elastoplastic deformation zone. The thickness and material of the plate prove to affect the elastic unloading after removal of the applied force. So, it must be considered while bending the busbars to the designed angle. Also, the bending moment is substantiated to increase with increasing the product of the plate width by the square of its thickness. The article develops and provides the practical recommendations how to choose and select the equipment for the production of bent electrotechnical busbars.

articleTitle: Implementation of Digital Remote Line Protection in Java Language
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: This paper introduces an algorithm for implementing distance protection of lines with polygonal and circular characteristics using the Java programming language. The analysis assesses the algorithm's performance for various types of relay characteristics during different short circuit scenarios. To conduct the analysis, a model of the protected line was developed in PSCAD/EMTD, which provided instantaneous values of currents and voltages during short circuits. An emergency COMTRADE file was generated to capture the process.For a visual representation of the distance protection operation, graphs are constructed, illustrating the relay's response under different conditions. These graphs also demonstrate how the relay characteristics impact the operation of the resistance relay, allowing a better understanding of the system's behavior.

articleTitle: An Electric Drive Traction Transmission of Diesel Train Based on The Induction Motor with A Phase Rotor
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: In this paper the new diagram of an electric drive transmission with traction induction motor and pulse control of the rectified current in the rotor circuit is proposed, which has a number of advantages over AC transmission diagrams with induction squirrel-cage traction motor, namely: in terms of efficiency (expected potential to increase is from 3.5 % up to 5%); in terms of the cost of the traction converter, the presence of self-synchronization of traction motors and a relatively simple control algorithm that ensures the independence of the current (torque) of the rotor, depending on the change in the motor parameters.In terms of operating costs, the proposed diagram occupies intermediate position between frequency control electric drives and a DC motor, and therefore is recommended for the modernization of diesel trains and locomotives with a DC motor.

articleTitle: Novel Current Sharing Control Method To Reduce Circulating Current in Multi-Bus Microgrids
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: In recent times, there has been a growing interest in AC microgrids due to their versatility in operating as both islanded and grid-connected systems. When operating in islanded mode, the widely favored primary control mechanism for managing load distribution among distributed generators is droop control. However, in the context of meshed microgrids, certain challenges arise due to load fluctuations and varying impedances in transmission lines. These challenges manifest as significant drawbacks, such as inaccurate current sharing and rise in circulating current values among parallel distributed generators. To address these concerns, this research paper introduces a novel current sharing approach that relies on real voltage and current feedback. This method is applicable to both single-bus and multi-bus microgrids. Notably, the proposed technique shows promise in effectively mitigating circulating currents to very low values, outperforming both droop control and existing approaches found in the literature. To substantiate the efficacy and resilience of this method, the researchers conduct comprehensive simulations using MATLAB/Simulink. The simulations serve to demonstrate the superior performance of the new current sharing technique in managing microgrid operations.

articleTitle: The Influence of The Hall Effect on the Performance of Electronic Accelerator Pedals
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: The Hall effect is one of the physical phenomena that impacts the operation of electronic accelerator pedals (EAPs) significantly. EAPs employ Hall Effect sensors for signal transmission, thereby enabling precise pedal position detection. This paper presents an overview study of the influence of the Hall effect on the performance of electronic accelerator pedals, including the core idea – creation of Android Automotive OS (AAOS) application, which allows the driver to change the sensitivity of the pedal while in the car. This approach can be a valuable solution for controlling engine response and behavior depending on operating conditions.

articleTitle: Analytical Dimension Of Cyber Security Of Ukraine: Answers To The Challenges And Prevention Of Hybrid Threats
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: The modern digital economy is marked by the active formation of the sixth technological order and the risks that civilization faces as a result of the introduction of the latest technologies. In cyberspace, the importance of protecting critical information infrastructure from cyberattacks is gaining importance. The research delved into the different factors that affect Ukraine's cyber security. It was analyzed how these factors are interconnected and modeled the strength of these connections. By doing so, it was identified the specific areas of influence and necessary measures to improve Ukraine's cyber security. These measures include raising awareness of cyber security, improving legislation and regulation, and investing in advanced technologies to combat cyber threats. It is emphasized that constant investments and attention to cyber security issues will enable Ukraine to continue protecting its digital infrastructure against a wide range of threats.

articleTitle: Synchronous Machine Elements Heating in Dynamic Modes
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: The distribution of local heating of the rotor elements in the dynamic modes of operation of synchronous machines used for the electric drive of gas compressor units is researched based on the analysis of the electromagnetic field and the data on energy losses as heat sources. The influence of forced convection after the start-up mode on the degree of temperature field equalization in massive rotor assemblies is analyzed. The modeling is carried out using the numerical finite element method. Comparison of calculated and experimental data on the heating of a small tooth of the rotor of a full-scale electric motor in a non-stationary mode under load is performed. It is shown that the numerical model satisfactorily agrees with real practice.

articleTitle: Change in the Term of Power Transformer Depending Operation on the Distribution of Load Current Harmonics
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: The article is devoted to the study of the change in the service life of a power transformer depending on the distribution of harmonics of the load current. In the visual programming environment, a model of the power consumption area with a power transformer was created to study the influence of current harmonics on the lifetime of the transformer. Using typical expressions, the influence of harmonics of the load current on the service life of the power transformer is calculated. The obtained results indicate that when the harmonics of the load current increase, the losses in the transformer increase. The results show that the temperature of the transformer increases as the frequency of the load current increases. This, in turn, indicates that the load current, with an increase in its frequency, leads to a reduction in the service life of the transformer.

articleTitle: Resiliency & Risks of the Electrical and Energy Engineering Higher Education in Ukraine: Impact of the War and Objectives for Post-War Recovery
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: The paper deals with the analysis of the changes in Ukraine's electrical and energy higher education in the conditions of a full-scale war of the Russian Federation against Ukraine in 2022-2023 and in the context of the tasks of post-war reconstruction of the country on an innovative basis. It has been found that the relevant network of higher education in the field of study "Electrical Engineering" in Ukraine generally reveals resiliency to the destructive impact of war, restrictions of martial law. Public demand and support for this training has increased, the advance number of students in bachelor and master programs has grown. From the institutional point of view, the network has undergone small structural changes. At the same time, new inefficiencies have been added to its existing regional disparities, fragmentation and dispersion, duplication of training in the same city, lack of doctoral programs in the specialty "145 Renewable energy sources and hydraulic power engineering". They include a significant decrease in the potential of 11 relocated institutions, a weakening of the network of training in specialty "144 Thermal power engineering", as well as doctoral training. On the basis of key institutional characteristics, "Group 10" of leading and promising universities has been singled out for priority state support, in particular regarding financing, in the conditions of wartime budget restrictions and the need to provide victory in the war and post-war recovery of the country. Appropriate recommendations have been formulated.

articleTitle: Modeling of Thermoelectric Modules with Thermal Stress Damping for Transport Electrical Equipment
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: The study establishes the necessity of utilizing damping layers to compensate for thermal stresses in the structures of thermoelectric modules for transportation electrical equipment through numerical simulation. A specific computational example analyzes two thermoelectric modules with identical dimensions of 50×42.5×9 mm and 39 thermocouples. Each of these two thermoelectric modules with damping contains a different number of lead damping plates. Additionally, a thermoelectric module without damping with a similar structure and dimensions is examined. Operational characteristics are obtained for both damped and undamped thermoelectric modules, considering variations in the operating current ranging from 0 to 3 A, and a comparative analysis is conducted. It is determined that the application of damping plates in the structures of thermoelectric modules did not lead to an undesirable decrease in the efficiency of the thermoelectric Peltier effect but resulted in reducing the thermal stresses to acceptable limits.

articleTitle: Electrotensiometry While Studying Plastic Deformation of Welded Cylindrical Samples
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: The electrotensiometry method is an indispensable tool for studying small elastic deformations of elements of building structures, operating equipment in oil refining and mechanical engineering. Tension resistors are widely used as sensitive elements of sensors, designed to measure forces, displacements, moments, pressures, etc. Often, determination of deformation field by electrotensiometers is the only possible method for studying the behavior of complex structures. The article presents the assumptions that justify the accuracy of measurements, selected electrical circuit, type of electrotensiometers, as well as measuring equipment. Experimental data results are presented in the form of graphs of the voltage change of the analog-to-digital converter depending on loading values after primary mathematical processing in the application package MathCad.

articleTitle: Spacecraft Magnetic Cleanliness Prediction and Control
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: Uncertain satellite multiple dipole magnetic field model calculated based on measured magnetic field. Magnetically quiet uncertain satellite calculated based on compensating dipole optimal placement. Both uncertain satellite magnetic field model and magnetically quiet compensating dipole placement calculated as nonlinear minimax optimization problem solutions. Both objective functions calculated based on scalar magnetic potential Gauss equations for spatial spherical harmonics and Legendre polynomials. Both optimization problem solutions calculated based on heuristic optimization algorithms. Uncertain satellite multiple dipole magnetic field model design and uncertain satellite magnetically quiet compensating dipole placement design for «Sich-2» family satellite are given.

articleTitle: A Review of Manufacturing Technologies of Soft Magnetic Composites for Electric Machines
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: In this article the review of the existing manufacturing technologies of the soft magnetic materials have been performed. The existing technological protocols for production of the electrically insulated powders and their further treatment towards manufacturing of the soft magnetic materials are provided. The influences of different technological processes on the mechanical, electrical and magnetic properties of the resulting soft magnetic materials have been reviewed and described. Finally, the usage and implementation of the soft magnetic composites in the field of electric motor design have been discussed.

articleTitle: Energy Resources as an Element of the Economic Potential
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: This article analyzes the use of energy resources as part of a company’s economic potential in the context of the current energy crisis. It was found that among the most significant problems of the development of domestic enterprises, regardless of the forms and methods of their activity, there are problems of high energy intensity of production processes. Based on the complex of reasons for their slow modernization, the one of the main directions of energy saving were considered, namely development of real algorithm that could become a methodological base for carrying out energy saving programs and making specific decisions. Based on this, an algorithm for making managerial decisions regarding the usage of alternative energy resources in the economic potential structure in the context of the need to lower enterprises energy intensity proposed.

articleTitle: Modeling and Research of Automatic Sun Tracking System On the Bases of Arduino
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: The paper presents studies on the effectiveness of the use of solar trackers in mobile platforms of solar panels. It has been proven that the use of solar trackers allows more than doubling the zone of maximum energy generation. The development of a small-sized laboratory stand for the study of mechatronic systems for automatic target tracking and positioning based on solar panels and a tracker that ensures the rotation of the platform along the light source, where experimental studies were carried out, is presented. The solar tracker has a mechanical movement system, a servo drive and an electronic position control unit that work out the hit of sunlight on the panel at an angle of 90<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sup> and thereby maximize energy generation.

articleTitle: Axiological Competence of Electrical Engineering Students in the Conditions of Martial Law
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: The relevance of the chosen topic is determined by the fact that the study of the axiological competence of students of electrical engineering specialties provides an opportunity to study the expectations, potential and orientation of engineers, to identify problem areas, the reaction to crisis phenomena (military conflict, difficult economic situation, social tension, etc.). The purpose of the scientific work is to study the axiological competence of students of electrical engineering specialties. The novelty of the research lies in determining the direction of changes in the axiological competence of students of electrical engineering specialties in the conditions of martial law. The study of axiological competences is important, because it is precisely those who study in colleges and universities today that depend on the restoration of the energy sector of Ukraine, social, technological and economic transformations, and the speed of integration into European science. Changes in axiological competences in the conditions of martial law are a certain challenge for education, as they require a significant revision of the content and forms of education, the implementation of educational innovations, etc.

Author Keywords: direction of changes in the axiological competence

articleTitle: Research-Based Learning: Integration of Artificial Intelligence into the Curriculum of Electrical Engineering Students
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: The main forms of application of artificial intelligence in engineering education are identified. The prospects of using artificial intelligence technologies in combination with Pop-Up Laboratories in the educational process of students of engineering, in particular electrical engineering, specialities are shown. Examples of the use of Pop-Up Laboratories and artificial intelligence based on computer vision to solve practical problems of classifying objects and situations in the context of autonomous driving are given. The consequences of the implementation of a science-based approach based on the integration of artificial intelligence technologies into the curriculum of students of electrical engineering specialities are determined.

articleTitle: Comparison of Photovoltaic System Performance under Different Conditions
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: With increasing energy prices, greater attention is being directed towards alternative energy sources. Common households are increasingly adopting photovoltaic systems to reduce their electricity costs. However, many households are unaware that various situations can impact the production of solar energy. In this contribution, a research study was conducted where a small portion of the photovoltaic panel was shaded. The results demonstrate how even minor shading can affect the production of electrical energy from the photovoltaic panel. Additionally, it is important to realize that many photovoltaic systems consist of photovoltaic panels connected in series. This contribution highlights how a single damaged or shaded photovoltaic panel can influence the production of other photovoltaic panels in the series.

articleTitle: Dynamics Loads of the Automated Electric Drive for Moving FKM-500 Filter-Press Plates
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: Operational loads have both static and dynamic characteristics. Dynamic loads occur during the operation of the considered mechanism, both during acceleration and deceleration periods, as well as during steady motion due to the movement of the moving element along an uneven path caused by the presence of the working environment on the elements over which the filter-press plates are moving. The dynamic loading is significant and affects the formation of plate-side displacements during their movement while performing the technological operation. Experimental studies of the load on the movement elements were conducted to determine optimal control modes for the filter-press plate movement mechanism, aiming to avoid overloading during stopping and filter jamming. To analyze the loading, discretization of random processes of the filter movement mechanism loading was performed. The sequence of calculating the statistical characteristics of the schematized dynamic process is presented. Based on experimental data, mathematical calculation of the results of schematization and the type of probability distribution law was carried out. To select the law that best reflects the experimental data distribution of load amplitudes, the Kolmogorov-Smirnov goodness-of-fit criterion was applied. According to the calculation results, it was found that the Weibull distribution law adequately reflects the distribution of amplitudes since its corresponding Kolmogorov-Smirnov criterion value is the smallest.

articleTitle: Usage Analysis of Hydrothermal Heat Pump Installations of Open and Closed Types
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: The article is devoted to the problem of assessing the efficiency of heat pump power installations depending on the origin of the primary natural source of thermal energy that is used in the operation of the heat pump. The results of testing two experimental installations with different sources of primary thermal energy were analyzed, namely: low-enthalpy energy of groundwater in the upper aquifer and the heat of surface waters. Both installations have the same thermal power, which makes it possible to evaluate the efficiency of these installations by comparing their energy and technical and economic indicators. Technological schemes of both installations and characteristics of measuring equipment are given. The results of experimental studies on the stability of the initial parameters of the natural coolant at different depths for both systems are provided. It has been established that the temperature fluctuation of the natural coolant during the heating season for the first installation is 0.5-2 °C, while for the second it is 8-9 °C. The most effective way of developing low-potential geothermal resources has been determined, taking into account the nature of the primary source of thermal energy and the design features of the selection system for the first installation of fluctuations in the temperature of the natural coolant during the heating period. Technical and economic calculations have shown that projects for the creation of heat pump installations based on aquifers have the greatest investment attractiveness. Such projects are characterized by a higher conversion rate and, as a result, the payback period for such projects is shorter

articleTitle: Comparison of the Energy Efficiency of Induction and PMSM Electric Drives with a 7.5 kW Output Power for Ventilation Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: the article presents the results of an experimental comparison of the energy efficiency of electric drives based on induction motor and permanent magnet synchronous motors with a nominal power of 7.5 kW, which operating in ventilation systems. The efficiency coefficient of the electric drives and its components: the electric motor and the electronic converter, which uses pulse-width modulation to regulate the rotation frequency, were experimentally determined. The energy efficiency class of the induction motor was confirmed, and the energy efficiency class of the permanent magnet synchronous motor was assigned. The results of the experiments showed that use of an permanent magnet synchronous motor drive allows reducing energy consumption during the operation of the ventilation system.

Author Keywords: permanent magnet synchronous motor electric drive

articleTitle: On the Issue of Determining the Design Parameters of Magnetic Systems with Concentrators for Extracting Ferromagnetic Particles from Dispersed Materials
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: The article discusses the problem of improving calculations when developing technical means for magnetic purification of dispersed agricultural raw materials. To solve this problem, the authors offer a scientifically based analysis of the design of a magnetic system with concentrators in order to develop mathematical methods for calculating working areas with spherical (or other shaped) bodies of certain sizes placed in them. Theoretical studies of particle dynamics in the working zone of field concentrators have been carried out. A design has been proposed for a separator for purifying dispersed materials from ferromagnetic impurities

articleTitle: Research of Single-Phase Current Rectifier in the Rectification and Recuperation Modes
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: The article presents a study of a single-phase current-source rectifier. The classic and improved power part of the rectifier, the structure of the control system and the study of energy indicators in the rectification and recuperation modes are presented. The control characteristics of the output current and energy indicators of the converter are determined. It is clear that when the control factor is reduced, the power factor is reduced due to the phase shift of the input current and voltage. To compensate for the reactive power component, a system of adaptive phase regulator of the modulating signal for PWM is proposed. Computer modeling of a single-phase current-source rectifier in rectification and recuperation modes with the proposed control system showed the implementation of a sinusoidal form of current consumed from the supply network and a power factor close to unity.

articleTitle: Effective Construction Schemes of Solar Hot Water Supply Systems and Process Control Tools
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: The work presents the configuration and characteristics of technological schemes for the construction of high-performance solar water supply systems. Two main technological schemes are compared - with the use of an intermediate tank and with a general storage tank. The work presents a model of the graphical user interface that provides the implementation of the main functions needed by operational personnel: selection and indication of modes, assignment of settings, control of the state of active elements, manual control of each executive device, log of abnormal situations, control of operating time of executive devices, cost control thermal and electrical energy.

articleTitle: Analysis and Prospects of Using Ultrafine-Grain Copper for Highly Loaded Cable Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: This scientific article delves into the analysis and prospects of utilizing ultrafine-grain copper for highly loaded cable systems. The potential applications of new ultra-fine-grained and nanostructured metal conductors in various fields, such as heavily loaded cable systems, windings of motors and generators, low-current computer networks, and devices operating under challenging conditions were explored. The article presents detailed analyses of the mechanical and electrical properties of ultrafine-grained copper and copper alloys. The influence of several plastic deformation on these properties is explored, and the results demonstrate a significant increase in the strength characteristics of the materials due to nanostructuring. However, the electrical conductivity of ultrafine-grained metals, including copper, is a complex phenomenon and depends on various factors, such as defects accumulated at grain boundaries. The research includes theoretical approaches, such as percolation models, to study and understand the electrical conductivity of ultrafine-grained copper. The obtained results revealed the evolution of the structure during intense deformation, showing a decrease in the size of the coherent scattering region and the presence of microstrains in the ultrafine-grained copper structure. These structural changes significantly impact the mechanical and electrical properties of the material, making it important to comprehend and optimize the applications of ultrafine-grained copper in electrical and energy systems.

articleTitle: Computer-integrated system of automatic balance control in centrifuge rotors with variable imbalance
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: The paper presents the developed computer-integrated system of automatic control of rotors balancing in centrifuges with variable imbalance. It includes a microcontroller, a Hall sensor, a computer-oriented Bond Graph model of an asynchronous motor, and a control program that, according to the proposed algorithm, checks the nominal and critical value of the centrifuge drive current. At the same time, the current values are recorded and the current is monitored. When the current increases, the system automatically resets the revolutions by 10% to reduce the amplitude of vibrations in the transient modes of their rotation with further control of the permissible current limit and engine load.

articleTitle: Study of the Ionizing Radiation Influence on the Induction Motor Main Circulation Pumps Electrical Insulation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: This article describes the study of the effect of ionizing radiation on the electrical insulation of induction electric motors VAZ 215/109-6AMO5 [1] of the main circulation pumps GTsN-195 of the primary cooling circuit of the nuclear reactor VVER-1000 NPP. There are 13 power units with this type of reactors in operation in Ukraine. The main requirement for the insulation system of powerful electric motors is that it must withstand operational impacts within the required resource. The study was carried out in order to determine the reliability of the operation of the stator windings of electric motors under the influence of ionizing radiation. The conducted studies of electrical insulation against the effects of γ-radiation are aimed at developing the simplest test methods, which will later be used to create durable and reliable insulation systems for the main circulation pumps of nuclear power plants. The purpose of this improvement is to ensure the safety and efficient operation of pumps under operating conditions at nuclear power plants.

articleTitle: Machine Calculation of the Problem of Expansion of the Magnetic Field Measurement Grid
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: Machine calculations of field problems and confirmation of adequacy of mathematical models of the numerical expansion of magnetic field measurements grid on a closed circuit are presented. The dimensionality of calculated numerical arrays is reduced due to artificial transitions from a spatial field problem to a problem on a plane. The article proposes a computer implementation of a mathematical model that significantly reduces the size of calculation arrays. Approaches for solving problems of instability of linear algebraic equations systems solutions by numerical methods are proposed. It also includes ways to check the obtained solutions with the help of known relations of the field theory and solutions of uncertainties that arise near the borders of elementary sites, segments and corners in the measuring grid. All the stated provisions are confirmed by a numerical experiment, the results of which are given in the article.

articleTitle: Pedagogical Discourse and Communicative Norms of Electrical Engineering Education in Great Britain and USA
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: A high school teacher, as a person who by profession is called to shape the competence of others, using a wide range of communicative strategies and tactics, must have developed communication abilities and skills, therefore the scientific problem of the communicative personality of the teacher is in the center of attention of linguistics. The issue also becomes relevant in connection with the European integration processes that affect the reform of Ukrainian electrical engineering education. A careful study of the best practices of the countries of the English-speaking world, in particular, Great Britain and USA, is necessary to take into account the positive assets of foreign pedagogical linguistics, rhetoric and discourse studies. This is due to the fact that the pedagogical discourse of electrical engineering education in Great Britain and the USA needs a scientific understanding in the communicative and functional aspect, namely in the study of communicative norms and ecological principles, which also determines the novelty of the work.

articleTitle: Mechatronic System for Management and Control of a Device for Applying a Polymer Coating
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: This article presents a comprehensive study on the design, simulation, and programming of a mechatronic device for the precise application of polymer coatings to flat parts. The device utilizes a two-coordinate system controlled by NEMA 17 motors to position the spraying mechanism accurately. The objective is to achieve a uniform and controlled deposition of the polymer, improving the coating quality and overall efficiency of the process. The simulation of the mechatronic device is performed using advanced modeling techniques, allowing for a virtual representation of its mechanical components and their interactions. The simulation results demonstrate the effectiveness of the device in achieving the desired coating outcomes while minimizing material waste and processing time. To realize the functionality of the mechatronic device, a customized control program is developed using a suitable programming language. The program enables the device to receive input instructions, such as a black and white image representing the desired coating pattern. The program processes the image, extracting the relevant information, and generates control signals for the motors and polymer spraying mechanism. These control signals govern the precise movement of the two-coordinate system and the activation of the spraying mechanism at the appropriate locations, ensuring an accurate replication of the desired coating pattern. Experimental validation of the mechatronic device is conducted using physical prototypes, where the programmed control algorithm is implemented on an Arduino microcontroller. The experimental results highlight the device's reliability, repeatability, and robustness in achieving consistent and high-quality coatings on various flat parts. The presented mechatronic device offers significant advantages in terms of precision, efficiency, and automation in the application of polymer coatings. The findings of this research contribute to the advancement of mechatronics and its applications in industrial coating operations, paving the way for enhanced product quality, reduced costs, and increased productivity.

articleTitle: Double Feed Inductor Generator Mathematical Model for Studying Generation Modes with Unbalance of Electrical Machine Parameters
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: The analysis of systems using dual power generators revealed a variety of models, most of which are built in the α-β and d-q coordinate systems. Models and control systems are made taking into account the unbalance of the voltage of the electrical network. A model of a three-phase dual-supply generator with the possibility of introducing asymmetry of the electrical parameters of the stator and rotor has been synthesized. Modes with symmetric and asymmetric parameters of the machine windings were modeled. Unbalance is implemented by changing the inductance and resistance of one of the stator and/or rotor phases. In both cases, the required generation mode was obtained both in terms of voltage frequency and its effective value. In the case of non-symmetrical diameters of the windings, asymmetry of the generated voltage and the occurrence of pulsations of the electromagnetic torque with a frequency of 100 Hz were noted. Using the approach to the analysis of the electric power caused by the voltage and current of forward, reverse and zero sequences, according to the simulation results, it was noted that in the case of asymmetry, along with the appearance of the components of the reverse sequence power, changes in the components of the forward sequence power occur. The indicated power components increase with increasing asymmetry of machine parameters.

articleTitle: Possibilities of Increase in Energy Efficiency and Unification of Transformer-Reactor Equipment with Twisted Elements of Magnetic Circuit
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: Increasing energy costs and the need for further energy conservation lead to an increase in the requirements for reducing losses in transformer and reactor magnetic circuits. Traditionally, transformer and reactor equipment is improved by applying the achievements of electromaterials science and new technologies to traditional structures and structures of electromagnetic systems. Recently, the use of amorphous steel strip with coiling technology has been expanding in the production of magnetic cores, which in three-phase versions are made three-circuit combined of elements and are characterized by 33% of additional losses. The improvement of three-phase transformers and reactors with twisted magnetic cores is possible by the method of structural transformations of active parts with magnetic coupling of phase twisted circuit elements. The options, advantages and disadvantages of these transformations are considered. On the basis of the identity of mathematical models and dimensionless indicators of the objective functions of structural and parametric optimisation of identical transformer and reactor designs, it is concluded that it is expedient to unify their electromagnetic systems with magnetic coupling of the twisted elements of jointed magnetic cores.

articleTitle: Heat Resistance Class Selection for the Stator Winding Insulation in the Circulation Pumps Induction Motors
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: this article gives a mathematical justification for the heat resistance class selection of the stator winding insulation when manufacturing the stator winding rods for the induction motor VAZ 215/109-6AMO5, which is the drive for the main circulation pump GTsN-195M in the nuclear reactor first cooling circuit VVER-1000. The topic of the article under consideration is important, since the main circulation pumps are designed to create forced circulation of the coolant in the primary circuit of the reactor plant.

articleTitle: Installation of Sectionalizers in a Radial Distribution Networks to Create an Emergency Islanded Network Powered by Distributed Generators During Outages
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: The paper considers the use of sectionalizers to isolate a damaged section of a medium voltage (MV) radial power network of 6-10 kV and create energy islanded network that can be powered by distributed generators (DGs). The configuration of power networks with one and two sectionalizers and a different number of DGs, which are separated over the network zones, is considered. To avoid the use of labor-intensive discrete calculations, the authors propose a simplified method for calculating the reduction of the expected energy not-supplied (EENS) to the consumers due to create energy islanded network. This method suggests replacing discrete load distribution with a standard function. All calculations come down to selecting the load distribution function and obtaining the result from the tables (placement of the sectionalizer and the EENS in this case). The table is easy to use when designing to find the optimal location for installing a sectionalizer in a power network.

articleTitle: Simulation of UAS Flight Parameters for the Software for Route Planning Under Different Weather Conditions
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: The development of technologies including digital ones opens new opportunities for such concepts as Industry 4.0 and Society 5.0. The realization of the concepts is based on the enhanced automation of different industrial processes as well as technical solutions to implement the IoT and IoE in many branches of people's activity. One of the elements or technological solutions that is expected for successful use in many industrial applications is unmanned aircraft systems (UAS). They can help to fulfill the range of tasks with mark advantages. At the same time, some hazards can restrict drone operations. Some of the hazards are connected with the cyber part of the UAS, as the modern UASs are the cyber and physical systems. Some hazards can be identified as unintentional and natural. Examples of hazards of this type are those connected with weather. In this paper, our plan is to demonstrate and discuss the UAS flight characteristics and approach to software development for meteorological support of both: the UAS operator and automated flight. The software automatically collects operative meteorological data and disseminates them simultaneously for flight trajectory planning and further operative correction to avoid potentially dangerous areas.

articleTitle: Determination of Floating Power Plant Parameters for Emergency Conditions in the Dnieper Basin
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: This article addresses the issue of meeting Ukraine's urgent electricity needs through the utilization of floating power plants. The focus is on ensuring the survivability of these plants during emergency situations. Emphasis is placed on the priority of employing energy modules based on medium-speed diesel and simple-cycle gas turbine technologies. The impact of power capacity on the overall parameters of floating power plants is analyzed, and statistical dependencies of energy module performance indicators within the 3 to 30 MW power range are established. Additionally, operational constraints for floating power plants in the Dnieper basin are provided, outlining maximum dimensions for length, width, draft, and height: 100 m, 16 m, 3.5 m, and 8 m, respectively. A mathematical model is developed to determine the power capacity of a floating power plant while considering these size limitations. It is found that, within the specified constraints, the maximum power capacity will range between 36 MW and 72 MW, with autonomy periods ranging from 1 to 2 weeks.

articleTitle: Modeling of Power Generation System Configurations with Parallel Operated Variable Pitch Wind Turbines
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: This paper deals with simplified modeling of power generation systems of wind farms. Two wind farm configurations with three wind turbines are considered. The first one is the basic configuration with parallel DC connection of AC/DC converters of variable speed wind turbines and medium voltage AC transmission. The second configuration is the wind farm configuration with parallel AC connection of variable-speed wind turbine generators, a centralized AC/DC/AC power converter and medium voltage AC transmission. Simplified mathematical models of power generation systems of said wind farm configurations are presented. Torque-reference based control algorithms were used to maximize power captured by blades of wind turbines. Limitation of extracted energy by blades is performed using pitch angle control. Considered wind farm configurations were simulated under fixed time delays between wind patterns of turbines. Simulated performances of considered configurations have been compared and briefly discussed.

articleTitle: Post Rejection Renewal of Mechanical Properties for Mild Steel Electrical Wire by Cold Multi-Pass Drawing
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: Steel wire is widely used for electrically conductive cables reinforcing, and the cheapest grades of mild steel are sufficient. From this point of view in the paper analyzed the strength requirements for electrical purposes steel wire, namely for the cores and armour of steel, combined steel-aluminum, and steel-copper cables. Produced by drawing wire of low-carbon S235JR steel is widely used for overhead power transmission lines, grounding connections, messenger wires, wire communication, antenna support on stretchers, etc. The necessity of the control and correction of the overheating defect at annealing after drawing in obtaining the wire of the required level of strength is shown. The basic target of the work was about the modes’ development for the steel wire grains grinding by cold plastic deformation by re-drawing. Five combination modes with cold drawing, annealing and overheating were investigated for ensuring the increase in strength indicators of the steel wire to S235JR grade requirements. An inequality is obtained for the relation between the stress equilibrium equation for the separation case of wire with sharpened end reduced area due to the indentation of the pincer claws to hold the ends of the wire. The cold drawing modes designing for overheated mild steel wire taking into account the conditions of this mathematical expression guarantee the removing of the wire end tensile breaks at both the beginning and the stable drawing stages.

articleTitle: Tracking System of a Micromanipulator Based on a Piezoelectric Motor
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: An analysis of modern research on closed piezoelectric electric actuators is provided. The problems that exist in these studies and the direction of mathematical modeling are defined. Based on the obtained electric drive transfer functions the conditions of absolute stability of the electric drive are determined. These conditions can be taken into account during electric drive microcontroller programming. Based on the conducted research, an experimental manipulator control system was created and the piezoelectric electric drive oscillograms were given.

articleTitle: Effectiveness Analysis of Using an Electric Drive with a Magnetic Gearbox for Cooling Tower Fan
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: The article analyzes the effectiveness of the use of a magnetic gearbox for the electric drive of a cooling tower fan. The technical feasibility of creating a cooling tower fan gear motor, which consists of an electric motor with permanent magnets and a magnetic gearbox, is shown. Numerical studies of the characteristics of a magnetic gearbox and an electric motor with permanent magnets have been carried out with varying sizes and configurations of the magnetic system. The considered scheme of the electric drive with a magnetic gear allows the use of an electric motor with a high rotation speed, which ensures high drive efficiency with small dimensions and weight. A comparison is made between an electric drive with a magnetic gearbox and with asynchronous and low-speed synchronous permanent magnet electric motors of cooling tower fans, which are currently widely used. The advantage of an electric drive with a magnetic gearbox is shown. The calculation of the characteristics of the investigated electric motors and magnetic gears were carried out in the Simcenter MotorSolve software package.

articleTitle: Aspects of Using Rotating Modes of Hydraulic Units in Pump Complexes
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: It is shown that pumping complexes of industrial and communal water supply are complex energy-intensive objects with low controllability in both normal and emergency modes of operation. It is proposed to use reversible modes of operation of turbomechanisms to increase the controllability of pump complex equipment. The structure of the system of active regulation of pump complex parameters with various options for including the adjustable hydroturbine unit has been developed. It is shown that active devices can perform both regulatory and protective functions. A device for controlling and protecting the pumping unit against water hammer based on an active water flow energy quencher is proposed. The algorithm of operation of the software control device of the electrohydraulic equipment protection system against excess pressure in the hydraulic network has been developed.

articleTitle: Research on the Use of Single-phase Autotransformers in Rural Networks to Stabilize Voltage Levels
