publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: An analysis of the problem of low quality electrical energy in rural utility networks in Ukraine and abroad was carried out. Ways to eliminate the low quality of electrical energy in these networks are considered. A calculation was performed for a conditional rural power distribution line using an autotransformer that adds voltage. To stabilize the voltage level in rural networks that supply the population, it is proposed to use a single-phase step-up autotransformer.

Author Keywords: low-voltage rural electrical networks for municipal purposes
balancing transformer for voltage level stabilization

articleTitle: Circuits-Field Aproach to Mathematical Modeling of Induction Motors for the Purposes of Optimal Design
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: For the purposes of optimal design of innovative constructions of induction motors, an approach to their mathematical modeling is presented, based on the use of the proposed weakly-coupled parameterized circuit-field mathematical model of the induction motor. The essence of this model and its difference from the well-known circuit-field model are described. The particular feature of the developed model is the determination of operational parameters and parameters of the equivalent circuit by sequentially solving the equations of the circuit and field mathematical models, respectively. Using a numerical study of the nominal mode of a series-connected induction motor as an example, the developed mathematical model is tested, assessing the accuracy and time complexity of the obtained results.

articleTitle: Simulation and Research of Autonomous Induction Generator with an Asymmetric Excitation System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: Autonomous induction generator can work in an asymmetric mode of operation, caused both by an asymmetric load (for example, single-phase) and by the asymmetric connection of capacitors that make up the excitation system. The impact of taking into account the dynamic component of the equivalent inductance characterizing the velocity of change of the inductance of the magnetizing circuit at saturation, which is constantly changing in the asymmetric mode of operation, on the results of calculating the quasi-steady modes of operation of an autonomous induction generator with an asymmetric excitation system is shown.

articleTitle: Investigation of Oscillatory Processes in Mechatronic Systems with a Robust H∞-controller
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: The article investigates oscillatory processes in mechatronic systems. It is shown that electromechanical oscillations are possible in the mechatronic system besides mechanical ones. One considers an electromechanical system where both types of oscillations can be observed. The unified structural scheme of the two-mass electromechanical system is given, resulting in the differential equation of motor rotor motion at a stepwise change of the control signal at the input. The article presents responses of the electromechanical system to the jump-like appearance of the control action when there is no mechanical damping and no mechanical damping and armature power supply from the current source. We have modeled the electromechanical system with a robust H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</inf> speed controller in the MATLAB/Simulink package. The paper presents the results of the electromechanical system with the synthesized H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</inf> speed controller when working out a closed-loop automatic control system of the set trajectory with a speed intensity setter.

articleTitle: Kalman Filter as Part of a Relay-Vector System Control of Asynchronous Electric Drive
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: The algorithm of the discrete extended Kalman filter as part of the relay-vector control system was developed for the purpose of identifying the speed and vector of flux coupling of the rotor an asynchronous machine. The dynamics of the control system with the joint operation of the relay regulators and the digital Kalman filter algorithm built into its structure for real-time identification of the state variables of the asynchronous machine were studied.

articleTitle: Prospects of Biogas for High-temperature Heat-technological Complexes in Glass Industry
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: Landfill gas as a fuel for continuous bath furnaces in the glass industry is proposed. The calculation study carried out showed that the addition of biogas in an amount of 15% to natural gas does not cause significant fluctuations in the combustion temperature and will practically not affect the temperature level in the furnace. Such use of landfill gas will provide savings of natural gas up to 1500 m3/day for furnaces of small capacity, as well as a significant environmental effect.

articleTitle: Welding Inverter Utilizing a 32-bit Microcontroller
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: This paper presents the design and implementation of a welding inverter utilizing a 32-bit microcontroller. The objective of this work is to enhance the control and performance of welding processes by leveraging the capabilities of a modern microcontroller. The welding inverter incorporates a 32-bit microcontroller as the central control unit, enabling precise regulation of welding parameters such as current, voltage, and pulse width modulation. The microcontroller's advanced processing power and integrated peripherals allow for real-time monitoring and adjustment of welding parameters, leading to improved welding quality, efficiency, and repeatability. Additionally, the microcontroller facilitates the implementation of advanced features such as digital interfaces, data logging, and control by touch screen options, enhancing the usability and versatility of the welding inverter. The experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness and reliability of the proposed welding inverter design, highlighting the potential for its application in industrial welding processes.

articleTitle: Web-Based Technology of Intellectual Analysis of Environmental Data of an Industrial Enterprise
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: Today, one of the main reasons for the increased mortality rate in the world is atmospheric air pollution, unfortunately, Ukraine is no exception. Industry and transport are traditionally the main air polluters in our country, having almost the same amount of harmful emissions. To monitor and regulate air quality, air pollution monitoring stations are located in almost all regions of the country. Given the air pollution problem, there is a need to create and implement a web application that will receive data from the stations and analyse it to avoid harmful effects. The practical problem is the lack of open archival environmental data and access to a specific air quality monitoring station. Therefore, this paper is devoted to displaying the analysis of environmental data obtained from the API resources on the website. The object of research is the process of obtaining and displaying environmental data. The subject of research is a web-based technology for intelligent analysis of environmental data. The purpose of the work is to inform the user about the state of air quality in a selected city of Ukraine and to demonstrate the analysis of data collected from ecosystem stations. The research methods were based on the data obtained from the SaveEcoBot API chatbot. The scientific novelty of the work is as follows: a method for quickly obtaining environmental data from monitoring stations has been developed; a method for processing data by intelligent analysis and displaying the results on a chart and map has been developed. In this paper, a web-based technology for analysing environmental data was created to enable users to monitor the state of air quality in Ukraine.

articleTitle: Problems in the Manufacture of Hydrogen Fuel Cells Bipolar Plates
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: The use of hydrogen as a fuel is an advanced promising direction in the development of environmentally friendly green technologies. The use of hydrogen fuel cells opens up broad prospects for the automotive industry development in the aerospace technologies and the energy complex. The metal bipolar plates are a key component of the proton membrane fuel cell. The ultra-thin plate is produced by sheet molding, providing the required ratio of the channels width and depth. To ensure the smallest thickness of the plate, the article analyzes the different influence of friction forces on the deformation conditions improvement. The experimental studies results at the titanium sheet molding, which was subjected to heat treatment, are presented.

articleTitle: Hybrid Shielding Approach for Magnetic Field Mitigation of Double-Circuit Overhead Line in Multi-Story Residential Building
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: Work presents a hybrid cleanliness approach effectively mitigate double-circuit overhead lines magnetic field multi-story buildings. Approach combines both grid shield and active cleanliness system to minimize initial magnetic field. Design process involves calculation optimal spatial position coordinates, as well as currents and phases of active cleanliness windings, while considering fixed grid shield. Optimization problem formulated as two-player multi-criteria game with payoff vector calculated using grid shield semi-analytical model. Game solution calculated based on heuristic optimization algorithm. Hybrid cleanliness results indicate capability effectively initial magnetic field mitigate to residential building living space reference level.

articleTitle: Increasing the Vibration Strength of Tubular Coolers of Transformers and Electrical Machines
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: The issues of operation of tubular coolers of transformers and electrical machines are considered in this study. Coolers during operation are exposed to the vibration loads, which are transferred from the units of the electrical machine structure. In addition, the vibrations occur when the system coolers are blown by fans. The vibration strength of coolers depends on their design and manufacturing technology. The vibration strength of the cooler elements was determined on the vibration stand of a special design. It is known that the tightness of the connection of pipes with the tube sheet is the main indicator of vibration strength. Calculation dependencies are proposed to determine the density of the layers for various options for connecting tubes with cooler tube sheets. In addition to the well-known connection options, high-energy methods for assembling pipes with tube sheets are also considered. The traditional methods include the following options such as circumferential welding, flaring, reinforcement when expanding a brass tube. In addition to fixing pipes by mechanical flaring (with or without reinforcement), welding, and gluing, the impulse pipe welding methods have been investigated. This is the methods of fixing of pipes with the use of the explosion, electric impulse and magnetic impulse pressing. The advantages of these methods over machining and argon arc welding are described. It is noted that the combined methods of pipe welding such as flaring and explosion welding, friction flaring and explosion welding are the most promising in these metalworking processes.

articleTitle: Double-Circuit Control System of the Electric Mode of an Arc Furnace with a Fuzzy Phase-by-Phase Asymmetrical Adjustment of Arc Lengths
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: A double-circuit automatic control system (ACS) of the electric mode (EM) of an arc furnace (AF) is developed. A model of a fuzzy phase-asymmetric rule for arc length regulation is proposed. A block diagram is developed and the design of an element for generating a mismatch signal of EM for AF is carried out according to the developed fuzzy rule. A Simulink-model of the developed double-circuit ACS of EM has been developed and comparative computer simulations of the quality indicators of controlling the EM coordinates for the proposed double-circuit structure of the ACS and the serial arc power regulator ARDM-T-12 of the DSP-200 arc furnace are carried out. The results of the comparative analysis have shown an improvement in a number of AF energy efficiency indicators and an increase in the dynamic accuracy of EM coordinate stabilization when regulating random disturbances by the double-circuit structure as compared to the arc power regulator ARDM-T-12.

articleTitle: Laboratory Stand for Studying the Automated Air Temperature Monitoring System Using IoT Technologies
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: Temperature monitoring in premises is one of the most frequent and typical tasks in industry, household, commercial and office premises. In classrooms and laboratories, the temperature significantly affects the quality and efficiency of the educational process, and must also comply with sanitary standards. Therefore, the organization of automated temperature measurement, online monitoring based on Internet of Things technology is an urgent task, of scientific interest and practical importance. A laboratory stand has been developed for the study and research of an automated online indoor air temperature monitoring system based on LoRaWAN wireless communication and a virtual tool that allows you to study temperature fluctuations throughout the day and optimize the efficiency of the use of air heating and cooling systems in educational premises. The use of this laboratory stand in the educational process contributes to the formation of students’ practical skills and the ability to configure an IoT-based system for real-time monitoring of the air temperature in the classroom, display the received data on the website in numerical and graphical form. In the future, improvements are planned at both the hardware and software levels, in particular, the setting of a message to the cross-platform manager channel about changes in settings and temperature exceeding the set limits.

articleTitle: Study of the Shock Loads Effect on the Operation of Multi-Motor Electric Drives of a Rolling Mill with a Second-order Elastic Coupling
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: This paper presents a study for optimizing a hot rolling mill. The paper is devoted to the study of ways to reduce the effect of shock loads of synchronous electric drives of the roughing mill group on the relative lengthening of the metal strip in the inter-stand gap of the rolling stands of the finishing mill group. The elasticity of the metal strip in the inter-stand gap of the rolling mill has a significant impact on the movement of intercoupled multi-motor electric drives of the finishing mill group. Another crucial route of exposure that influences the motion of the electric drives within the finishing mill group involves the electromagnetic connection between the drives in the roughing and finishing mill groups. The impact of the electromagnetically connected circuits is evident through the effect of shock loads from synchronous electric drives on the angular velocity of the direct current electric drives within the finishing mill group. The characteristics of the electromagnetic communication circuit are established by the power grid arrangement and equipment specifications. To assess the quality of work of electric drives of the finishing mill group, it is proposed to use the relative lengthening of the metal strip in the inter-stand gap, which is an important indirect indicator of the quality of rolling. The mathematical model of a hot rolling mill that takes into account both the elasticity of the metal strip that connects the DC electric drives of the finishing group, and the electromagnetic coupling circuit that takes into account the impact loads of synchronous electric drives of the roughing group on the example of the mill 1700 of ArcelorMittal Temirtau JSC was proposed in this paper. Using the mathematical model developed in Simulink software using the methods of planning the experiment, regression models were obtained to establish the dependence of the parameters of overexcitation of a synchronous motor on the magnitude of the voltage sag in the node of the power grid system and the relative lengthening of the metal strip in the inter-stand gap. The obtained results will improve the quality of the finished product of the rolling mill.

articleTitle: Measurement of Reflection and Shielding Effectiveness of Electromagnetic Fields in Construction Materials with Subsequent Calculation of Absorption
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: In today’s world of wireless technologies, we observe a proliferation of devices that communicate and operate wirelessly. All these devices emit electromagnetic radiation, which also penetrates the human body. Given the current technologies, it is not possible to completely prevent the impact of electromagnetic radiation on humans. However, we can mitigate the effects of electromagnetic radiation by choosing the right shielding material. One natural shielding material, for example, is a building. Therefore, in this article, we focused on research in the field of electromagnetic field shielding, reflection, and absorption in building structures. The article describes a measurement method for determining the effectiveness of shielding and reflection of electromagnetic fields. Subsequently, based on these measurements, the absorption of electromagnetic fields can be calculated.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence from Industry 5.0 Perspective: Threats and Challenges
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: Artificial Intelligence represents an exciting frontier for Industry 5.0, but it also poses new threats and challenges. Unlike Industry 4.0, Industry 5.0 emphasizes human intelligence in the manufacturing process and sustainability. By combining technological advancements with human expertise, one can establish a manufacturing process that will be adaptable and highly efficient. The incorporation of AI and machine learning enables opportunities to produce customized products on a large scale still being cost-effectiveness. The paper examines the potential downsides of AI, such as job displacement, algorithmic bias, and security risks. The objective of this scientific investigation is to examine the potential downsides of AI and provide a roadmap and examples of the use of artificial intelligence technologies by the EU to create new products and services; improvement of existing offers; automation - this experience can be useful for the post-war reconstruction of Ukraine's economy. As a result of this, it's important to work together to create ethical frameworks and guidelines for AI development and deployment. By doing so, we can harness the power of AI while minimizing its negative impacts.

articleTitle: Competence Approach in Modern Engineering Education of Ukraine: Assessment of Development
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: Modern European education is built on the formation of competencies of higher education institutions graduates, the list of which is defined in regulatory and legal acts, including within the "frameworks of qualifications". In the normative field of Ukraine, the lists of competencies are determined by the higher education standards, the creation of which began in 2018 and should be completed in 2023. The Ukrainian higher education standards contain integral, general, special (professional, subject) competencies and program learning outcomes. The Law of Ukraine "On Education" contains a list of key competencies that partially corresponds to the list of key competencies in the European Qualifications Framework. We conducted an analysis of the list, titles and content of competencies in Ukrainian higher education standard of 141 specialty (Electrical Power Engineering, Electrical Engineering and Electromechanics) at the bachelor's level of education, which revealed the inconsistency with the lists of key competencies of Ukraine and the EU. We proposed changing the titles, grouping, disclosure of the competences content in higher education standards, introducing new competences into the lists of standards and key competences, setting requirements for the levels of competence formation in accordance with the educational levels in the higher education standards and the definition of the content of each level of competence, which will contribute to the harmonization of national legislation of Ukraine to the European legal system (acquis communautaire) in the course of European integration.

articleTitle: State and Prospects for the Development of Energy Management Systems in Ukraine and the EU
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: Today, due to the loss of capacity of the Ukrainian power system as a result of Russian aggression, the issue of energy efficiency and energy saving is one of the most important to address. The experience of the EU countries has shown that the key approach to improving energy efficiency is to implement an energy management system. A number of improvements in the energy management system in relation to public utilities in the EU countries have been studied: designing low-energy buildings, improving buildings, installing solar power plants, replacing heating systems, and promoting energy consumption behavior among citizens. The positive practice of implementing energy saving measures among municipal institutions in Luxembourg is outlined, according to the approved measures, energy efficiency will increase by 44%. The tendency of energy management implementation in Ukraine by years is analyzed. The article outlines four main objectives of municipal energy efficiency programs in Ukraine. In accordance with the signed EU-Ukraine Energy Efficiency Directive, priority goals have been identified. The EU grant programs for Ukraine were monitored to enable the implementation of an energy management system.

articleTitle: Modeling of a Decentralized System for Maintenance of Production Equipment Based on Transport Robots
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: The work describes the principle of organizing the maintenance process of production equipment at a modern enterprise based on transport robots. Based on the analysis, the principle of organizing the movement of intelligent autonomous mobile robots is proposed, which combines the principle of a dedicated lane for the movement of transport robots and a grid of reference points through which the paths of many possible trajectories can be laid. The structure of the software that simulates the work of robotic production using autonomous mobile robots is described. The program is built according to the principles of a multi-agent system, where each mobile robot is represented as an independent software agent. Algorithms of the software tool are described. Examples of the results of modeling the behavior of software robots are provided. The results of experimental studies are presented.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence Tools for University Fundraising 5.0: A Comprehensive Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: University Fundraising 5.0 represents the latest paradigm shift in this domain, one that resonates with the European Union's transformative vision of Industry 5.0. This visionary approach to fundraising not only incorporates cutting-edge technologies but also emphasizes collaboration, sustainability, and social impact, aligning seamlessly with the broader European framework of Industry 5.0. We applied horizon scanning methods, such as AI-Human Collaboration through information scanning and technological analysis, to classify and functionally organize artificial intelligence (AI) tools that can be applied in universities. Through the analysis of 61 platforms and services related to AI and fundraising, along with a systematic classification of AI tools based on functionality, implementation, and other relevant criteria, this research offers valuable insights for universities in selecting the most suitable AI tools to meet their specific fundraising requirements and objectives. The analyzed platforms provide various solutions, including AI tools, cloud computing, machine learning, data analytics, data visualization, natural language processing, fraud protection, contact data management, social media community management, content optimization and personalization, as well as fundraising and donor database management tools for non-profit organizations. Study highlights the potential future prospects and implications of integrating AI technologies in university fundraising beyond donor interactions. It opens up avenues for further research on AI applications in areas such as grant management, corporate partnerships, and foundation collaborations. Exploring these perspectives can provide universities with a comprehensive understanding of the broader impact of AI on their overall fundraising strategies and financial sustainability. The research findings contribute to advancing the understanding of AI's potential in university funding and fostering innovation in higher education.

articleTitle: Digital transformation as the heart of the state environmental policy regarding innovations
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: The article examines the impact of the digital transformation of state environmental policy on innovative activity. The experience of the leading countries of the world regarding the goals and tools of environmental policy, which are implemented by methods of digital transformation, is summarized. A comparative analysis of indicators of digitization and innovation activity in Ukraine and other countries around the world was carried out. The key tasks in the sphere of digital transformation in relation to the ecological sphere have been determined. It is proposed to develop the Digital Agenda of the state's environmental policy.

articleTitle: Increasing Efficiency of the Floating Electricity Power Generation with Variable Speed Reciprocating Engines
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: The problem of the cost efficient electricity generation on the floating power plants on the base of the oil and gas fuels. Software package developed at the CEAS Engine calculations department of MAN B&W was exercised for engine's parameters estimation. The internal combustion engine model provides the relationship between the set of boundary parameters and the set of design parameters, identifies working fluids and energy carriers: air, exhaust gases, coolant and fuel. High efficiency of floating facility is reaching due to extremely low specific gas fuel consumption of the main engines. The next step is the usage variable speed diesels for electricity generation into wide load modes. It allows increasing engine's fuel efficiency due to operation at rational modes at reducing power. This way needs special electrical and mechanical equipment. Efficient is solution with an eltctronical power converter connected to the diesel-driven generator. Instance, MAN B&W marine diesel engine 12G95ME-C10.6-LPSCR has the following main indexes: specified maximum continuous rating 82.4 MW and specific fuel oil consumption in specified mode 161.5 g/kWh. The main indexes of this engine and facilities on its base in standard ISO, tropical and specified ambient conditions were determined. Low-grade heat sources can be converted into electricity production and increased one engine power up to 95.2 MW. In this case specific fuel oil consumption is decreasing to 141 g/kWh or 13%, approximately.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of a Power Frequency Converter
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: This article focuses on the design of a power frequency converter specifically tailored for the control of asynchronous motors. It delves into the intricate details of the hardware connection design, elucidating each constituent element's role and functionality within the system. The heart of the article lies in the practical illustration of the frequency converter's design principles. It outlines a comprehensive example of how the converter's components come together to form a functional system. This includes an in-depth explanation of the individual parts and their interconnections, providing readers with valuable insights into the converter's architecture. Furthermore, the article culminates with a practical demonstration of the designed frequency converter. This demonstration serves as a real-world validation of the design, offering concrete evidence of its functionality. Notably, the article showcases measured waveforms as a part of this demonstration, providing a visual representation of the converter's performance.

articleTitle: Modified Discrete Neural Network PID Controller for Controlling the Helicopters Turboshaft Engines Free Turbine Speed
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: The focus of this study is the enhancement of the neuro-PID controller for regulating the free turbine speed in helicopters turboshaft engines. This is achieved through the integration of a nonlinear PID controller, implemented using a dynamic neural network with direct data transmission. The neural network comprises neurons with a radial-basis activation function in the first layer and adalines – neurons with a linear function activation – in the second layer. The optimization of PID controller coefficients is accomplished by transitioning to a discrete representation of the PID controller. This reduced the transient time from 3.0 seconds to 0.75 seconds, and reduced the overshoot from 5.0 % to 0.5 %.

articleTitle: System Electromechanics Adaptive Modular Platform Concept for Research on Electric Machines and Electromechanical Devices
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: The reasons for the non-compliance of the organization and bench support of physical experiments with modern requirements related to the educational field of knowledge production are analyzed. It is shown that the creation of bench equipment based on multi-purpose technological platforms with wide adaptive capabilities is a promising way to solve the mentioned problems. The concept of a System electromechanics (SEM) modular platform is proposed, the scientific-methodological and informational basis of which is determined by the system-genetic paradigm of the organization of the educational environment. The genetic nature of modularity is revealed, based on the results of its analysis, the choice of the dominant generic geometry is justified, which provides a wide range of structure formation of the research object from a limited number of functional modules. The construction of a Smart-stand with an adaptive space of modular structuring of the active zone of the research object is proposed, which allows the direct participation of the researcher to form the structure and carry out experimental studies of various types of electromechanical objects. Attention is focused on the possibilities of organizing an intellectual educational environment, which allows for the formation of individual scientific and educational trajectories through the convergence of the prognostic potential of genetic programs of structure formation, the cognitive mechanisms of the researcher's thinking and the adaptive space of the Smart-stand. The SEM modular platform represents the concept of a modular smart laboratory of the new generation, scientific and methodological support, the structure and functions of which are endowed with wide adaptive possibilities for the setting and execution of highly intellectual tasks of the corresponding educational or research program.

articleTitle: Possible Prospects and Emerging Challenges for Use of AI for Educational Purposes
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: The paper presents the results of research on the integration of artificial intelligence (AI) into the educational system, the pedagogical process and training programs. The introduction of AI technologies at all levels in education creates new opportunities for optimizing the management of the learning process, facilitating its monitoring and evaluating the final results, analyzing and introducing innovative teaching methods. Ethical issues are becoming relevant again, raising a number of questions related to the admissibility of the use and regulation of these systems, the impact of ethical norms on the decision-making process of the program, questions of the legal personality of AI. The results proved the practical value and viability of the concept of using intelligent systems and applications based on AI. Ethical conflicts and possible problems in the interaction of AI with the object and subjects of the pedagogical process are established, various options are proposed to prevent such disagreements and eliminate the negative consequences of integrating artificial intelligence.

articleTitle: Development of Smart Partnerships in the Field of Renewable and Alternative Energy at the Stage of Post-War Reconstruction in Ukraine
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: The article examines the processes of interaction between the state and business in the form of partnerships based on a smart approach in the field of renewable and alternative energy, which will be important at the stage of Ukraine's post-war recovery. The experience of functioning of partnerships in the field of infrastructural energy projects in different countries of the world is summarized. The war changed the energy situation not only in Ukraine, but also in the countries of Europe and the world, which requires the development of a comprehensive policy for the development of the energy security of the European continent. The purpose of the article is to develop energy development scenarios with an emphasis on renewable and alternative energy, taking into account the consequences of the war and the long-term need for energy resources in Europe and Ukraine. Application of the smart approach to offer effective partnerships in the field of energy based on the development of scientific and technical cooperation.

articleTitle: Remote Learning as a Catalyst for Changes in the Management of the Educational Process
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: Long-term pandemic restrictions have forever changed approaches to work management and training. The remote format demonstrated the effectiveness of existence even during the long military operations in Ukraine. Over the past few years, both the Ukrainian and global labor market and educational services have seen dynamic changes affecting the education and labor system. In a very short period of time, workers in this field had to very quickly reorganize their activities, which were transferred to the virtual space. During this time, an internal evaluation was carried out, the purpose of which was to examine what are the benefits and what are the risks of studying and working remotely. During the study, information was collected from various sources: lecturers and students. Data was collected using research methods. Today, after nearly three years of studying and working remotely, we can draw some conclusions and summaries. The article presents and discusses many activities undertaken by the governing bodies, rectors, and individual lecturers, wanting to ensure the continuity of the educational process.

articleTitle: Sun-tracking Solar Panel with Battery Charger Based on the MPPT Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: The energy crisis is a massive problem in today's world. Conventional energy sources are not only limited but also major contributors to environmental pollution. Renewable energy sources are becoming priorities worldwide. To reduce dependence on conventional energy sources, it is necessary to explore alternative options. Solar energy is rapidly gaining attention as an important means of expanding the use of renewable energy. Solar cells, which convert solar energy into electrical energy, are expensive and relatively inefficient. Various mechanisms and systems are used to increase the efficiency of solar cells and maximize energy generation. A solar tracking system is used to enhance the efficiency of solar cells by tracking the movement of the sun. This article describes the methodology for designing an automatic solar tracker based on the ESP32 microcontroller. Light-dependent resistors (LDRs) are used as sensors to detect the current position of the sun. The proposed tracker has a precise control mechanism that adjusts the orientation of the solar panel based on the measured values from the LDRs to achieve the optimal position perpendicular to the sun, ensuring the highest productivity in energy generation. The result is a constructed small-scale prototype of a solar tracking system, along with a description of its components and the programming part.

articleTitle: Improving the Quality and Response Speed of the Frequency and Power Control Systems of the Hydraulic Turbines
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: The article is devoted to improving the quality of electricity produced by hydraulic power stations by ensuring high static and dynamic precision of automatic control systems of hydraulic turbines. Energy efficiency and the use of renewable energy meet the goals of sustainable development of the UN and ensure the sustainable development of the domestic energy industry. On the basis of solving the inverse problem of the dynamics of the automatic regulation system of the hydraulic turbine, a structural synthesis of a universal precision regulator capable of compensating static and dynamic regulation errors was performed. The developed scientific and technical solutions are capable of increasing the precision of frequency and power regulation of hydraulic units of hydraulic power stations (and, accordingly, the stability of the frequency of generated electricity) by 3-5 times (from 0.3 to 0.1-0.05%) and proving these indicators to the level of international standards.

articleTitle: Research of the Vibration Mode of Combustion of Water-Fuel Emulsion for Improving the Efficiency Indicators of the Power Plant
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: The process of oscillating fluctuations of the gas flow begins during the combustion of the water-fuel emulsion as a result of microexplosions of its droplets, therefore, theoretical studies of thermo-acoustic processes in the combustion chamber when using pre-prepared water-fuel emulsion must be considered, starting from the mechanism of phase transformations of the water-fuel emulsion. Therefore, in this article, possible mechanisms of self- excitation of acoustic vibrations, features of the burning of emulsion droplets, which are presented graphically in the form of dependencies, were considered. The mechanisms of phase transformations in water-fuel emulsion droplets were studied, which made it possible to obtain an acoustic impulse of the combustion process of water-fuel emulsion in the combustion chamber of the power plant.

articleTitle: Development of an Electropneumatic Vehicle Brake Drive
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: The article is in the course of the study, it was determined that with a three-phase adjustment of the braking torque, it is possible to stabilize the wheel rolling process due to the stretching of the process of filling the brake chamber with a working fluid. It has also been found that adjusting the braking torque is necessary to perform at high speeds of the wheeled vehicle (WV) according to the angular acceleration of the automobile wheel, since it grows faster than the slip tires relative to the road surface, and vice versa, with a small initial braking speed of the vehicle (no more than 8 m s<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>), the slip reaches critical values faster than the acceleration of the car wheel, so the braking torque must be adjusted according to the slip.Based on the analysis of the obtained results, for further improvement, the nature of the change in pressure in the electropneumatic brake drive (EPBD) electro-pneumatic apparatus is proposed when implementing the axial control principle, which makes it possible to reduce the consumption of the working fluid when performing the anti-lock braking system (ABS) function in the electro-pneumatic brake drive. The main difference between the proposed principle of controlling the pressure modulators of the electro-pneumatic brake drive from the existing ones is the stretching of the processes of filling the working fluid with the DE-links of the brake system drive within the pressure change from 0.2 to 0.5 MPa for a time of no more than 0.6 s.A mathematical description of the working process of an electro-pneumatic drive with an ABS function under various operating conditions of the movement of a wheeled vehicle is made.Modeling the working process of changing the pressure in the brake drive of the WV, taking into account the peculiarities of the interaction of automobile wheels with the road surface, showed that forced stretching of the process of filling the brake chambers with EPBD gives an overall positive dynamics of the braking process of the WV, while the number of cycles of operation of the automated brake control system is reduced by 20-30% without significant change in the braking performance of the wheeled vehicle. It should also be noted that the load of the brake mechanisms when the process of filling the brake chambers is stretched decreases, which means that their durability increases.

articleTitle: Transformation of Education in the Context of Modern Informational and Cultural Realities of Artificial Intelligence ChatGPT Application
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: The article is intended to provide an idea of the role of artificial intelligence in education in the postmodern situation. The emergence of ChatGPT with artificial intelligence has caused concern in society about possible threats and negative consequences, in particular, for education. Publications abound with warnings that artificial intelligence is capable of surpassing human intelligence. Therefore, the article substantiates the inability of ChatGPT to generate innovative ideas of the level of social intelligence. The generation of ideas by artificial intelligence burdened by formal logic does not accommodate innovation. The provision on the priority of authentic intelligence over its artificial prototype is substantiated. The role of integrity, responsibility and other personal qualities of the acquirer of knowledge in the application of the capabilities of artificial intelligence is revealed. The result of penetration of artificial intelligence into the area of postmodern cultural transformations is the humanitarianization of education in general and engineering in particular, overcoming its alienation from the value demands of society. The representation of reality in professional creativity is the parity of rational and irrational forms of knowledge. Professional competence involves systematic knowledge based on the integration of natural, mathematical, technical and social sciences, rethinking the very philosophy of education. The conducted experiment proved that in modern projecting as a mutual condition of divergent and convergent thinking, the advantage in the selection of ideas for innovation belongs to artificial intelligence. It is noted that with proper organization, the involvement of ChatGPT will lead to the intensification of the educational process, will become a personalized assistant for the student, a means of his release from routine work. It is mentioned that the expressed moderate optimism regarding the prospects of education in the realities of artificial intelligence conditions is based on the philosophical understanding of the priority of social creativity over its machine organization.

articleTitle: Educational Potential of ChatGPT: Teaching Tool for Students’ Competencies Development
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: The article has characterized ChatGPT as widespread application in various aspects of higher education and considered some potential benefits of ChatGPT as well as the challenges and barriers that may arise from its integration in education. Utilizing SWOT-analysis the authors have assessed strengths, weaknesses, opportunities, and threats of ChatGPT in the context of its application in education. The article proves that ChatGPT can be used as a tool to spur students’ inner feedback and aid their learning and professional skills development. The authors point out that the use of Chat GPT in teaching electrical engineering students may raise ethical issues, such as privacy and data security concerns. It is emphasized that integration of ChatGPT in the educational process should be accompanied by appropriate pedagogical strategies, human oversight, and a balanced approach to ensure its effective and responsible usage. Using the interview method, the perception of ChatGPT by electrical engineering students of Kremenchuk Mykhailo Ostrohradskyi National University has been analysed. The authors have also presented recommendations on how ChatGPT can be used during practical classes in Ukrainian Language for Specific Purposes to electrical engineering students.

articleTitle: Balance of the Rare-Earth Elements Market: Prospects for the Development of Green Energy
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: The importance of balancing energy sources for domestic and industrial needs has been justified to achieve the Sustainable Development Goals, announced and approved by the United Nations. It has been the key trend of the energy transition, the main tasks and problems of implementing programs to stimulate the development of renewable energy sources in different countries. It was determined that rare earth elements, which are widely used in renewable energy sources and modern consumer electronic devices, are of great importance for the production of carbon-neutral technologies. The demand for rare earth materials has significantly decreased with improved technologies and the transition to greener and more efficient energy sources, particularly in solar and wind energy production. The situation in the rare earth metals market has been studied, and the presence of crisis phenomena and shortages caused by the confrontation between the key producers in the market – the USA and China has been established. The influence of geopolitical processes, the intensification of international competition, and, as a result, the complication of the situation with the satisfaction of the demand for rare earth metals determine the feasibility of further research on the search for mechanisms to achieve equilibrium in this market. The study of this issue is of particular importance from the point of view of ensuring the whole possibility of an ecological energy approach.

articleTitle: Promoting Sustainable Development Literacy: Strategies to Enhance Students' Understanding of the SDGs
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: Nowadays, countries worldwide increasingly recognize the need to invest in the well-being of future generations and embrace Sustainable Development (SD). In this context, the Ukrainian institution of education is a crucial actor in the nationwide SD strategy, as it significantly contributes to shaping the worldviews and attitudes of young individuals. The empirical study revealed that while the majority of students share the fundamental values of the SD concept, they have limited awareness of the SD methodology, current UN documents, and ISO standards pertaining to sustainable development. To overcome this gap, it is proposed to integrate the SD methodology elements into the educational process. This study presents potential educational strategies to enhance students' understanding of the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), offering additional benefits such as internationalization opportunities and the development of essential soft skills through collaborative project-based learning.

articleTitle: Computational Assessment of the Influence of the Structure of High-Frequency Capacitive Glow Discharges on the Excitation Homogeneity of the Active Medium of a CO2-Laser
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: The purpose of this study is to investigate and compare the structure of high-frequency capacitive glow discharges obtained at different frequencies of high-frequency current and to evaluate their compliance with the requirement of the active medium excitation homogeneity in a CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>-laser with convective cooling. The power supply scheme of the glow discharge with alternating high-frequency alternating current was considered. For the positive column plasma of the high-frequency capacitive glow discharge of a CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>-laser, the calculation of the voltage drop on the gas gap, on the dielectric, as well as on both of them together at different frequencies and a current density of 20 mA/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> was performed. The structure of the α-form and γ-form of the high-frequency capacitive glow discharge was reviewed; their compliance with the requirement of the active medium excitation homogeneity in the CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>-laser with convective cooling was evaluated.

articleTitle: dComFra DC-office as a Capacity Building Tool for Electrical Engineering and Information Technologies Institute
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: The article examines the results of the implementation of the international project "Digital competence framework for Ukrainian teachers and other citizens" (dComFra) within the framework of the Capacity Building in Higher Education of the Erasmus+ program in the conditions of Kremenchuk Mykhailo Ostrohradskyi National University. The impact of the project on various aspects of the activity of the Electrical Engineering and Information Technologies Institute of Kremenchuk University is shown. Approaches to the multifaceted use of the Office of Digital Competencies which were developed on the basis of the project are revealed.

Author Keywords: impact at the local and national level blended learning technology

articleTitle: Modeling of Vortex Multi-Phase Aerosols and Their Transparency Assessment Under Different Conditions
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: Military air forces and civil aviation of any country operate helicopters. Very often, helicopters are forced to take off or land on unprepared sites. This often happens during rescue operations, hostilities, and in countries with an arid climate. The cloud of dust and abrasive particles rising into the air is dangerous for the crew and significantly reduces the life of the engines. One of the ways to solve the issue of improving the conditions for landing a helicopter is to equip it with electronic vision and notification systems. Before the development of auxiliary electronic systems or automatic systems, it is necessary to mathematically describe the air vortices with solid particles formation processes. The use of means of modeling the movement of solid particles in an air vortex, approaches to the process of modeling the movement of particles in air vortices created by main rotor blades are considered. The calculated trajectories of the movement of solid particles are shown.

articleTitle: Modern Ukrainian Electrotechnical Terminology: Normative Aspect of Term Formation and Term Usage
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: The article examines the current state of the terminological system of the electrical engineering industry through the prism of normalization activity – unification, codification and standardization – at different linguistic levels, in particular lexical and word-forming ones. The authors have defined the research methods in the field of terminology, and also proved that the study of the peculiarities of the creation and functioning of the term is a priority task, since scientific research and the evolution of society require clarification and correction of concepts, generalization and organization of knowledge about them. Taking into account the Ukrainian language requirements for scientific and technical terms, the authors have pointed out the difficulties of the translation and interpretation of some terms, evidenced in the works of specialists. With reference to the state standards of Ukraine and professional dictionaries, some recommendations on term usage and term creation have been provided.

articleTitle: Energy policy of Ukraine and EU: Transformation Under Martial Law
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: For over 500 days, Ukraine has been facing Russia's full-scale invasion, enduring daily air strikes on critical infrastructure, including energy facilities. Concurrently, Europe, which has long relied on Russian gas, is striving to reduce its dependence on it, leading to fluctuations in energy pricing. In response to these challenges, the EU introduced the REPowerEU initiative in May 2022, aiming to significantly boost the share of renewable energy sources for enhanced energy independence. Now, one year later, this article seeks to analyze, compare, and synthesize the initiatives and viewpoints presented by international organizations, the European Union, and experts regarding the energy policy vision and changes in Ukraine and the EU. It will assess the progress made towards achieving the set goals for renewable energy sources, shedding light on the plans' effectiveness and potential impact on energy security and sustainability. Also, the results of the study show that one of the factors in the revision of the EU energy policy is the constant increase in greenhouse gas emissions. Accordingly, the EU is constantly increasing the share of renewable energy sources. At the same time, the EU is starting joint gas purchases. In order to form a sustainable energy policy, Ukraine needs to integrate with the energy systems of the EU countries; follow decarbonization; to optimize the generation and balancing structures of the energy system; to increase energy efficiency.

articleTitle: Interactive Posters as a Learning Tool for Practical Tasks in the Context of Electrical Engineering Education
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: The article presents the technology of creation interactive posters as a learning tool for practical tasks in electrical engineering. One of the major challenges in education can be overcome by using interactive elements: getting students' attention, keeping their interest, and engaging them in cognitive activity. There are some peculiarities in creation learning tools for studying electrical engineering, the using of interactive posters can help to overcome difficulties in the learning some engineering concept, calculations and working with drawings and schemes, visualization of processes. There are outlined the main directions of using interactive posters in practical tasks for electrical engineers. The proposed technology included the stages of choosing of the learning material, creation the main page of the interactive poster, adding different types of learning tools and conduction of control measurements. The obtained results were checked statistically that confirms the efficiency of the technology of creation interactive posters as a learning tool for practical tasks in the electrical engineering.

articleTitle: Methodology for Designing the Capacity of Solar Power Plants for an Offline Home Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: Power generation through solar cell power plants is a widely adopted global practice, with the utilization of solar panels experiencing continuous expansion. Numerous factors contribute to this trend, with a primary emphasis on the utilization of alternative (renewable) energy sources, gaining heightened significance in recent times. The ongoing enhancements in solar cell power plant technology enable their versatile applications. Autonomous solar power plants, those not connected to industrial power grids, are specifically designed for powering isolated locations such as small country houses, summer cottages, sports grounds, and communication nodes. The novelty of this work lies in addressing critical gaps in existing literature by providing a systematic approach to dimensioning autonomous solar power plants, considering factors such as location, electrical load, and operational patterns. The practical proposed methodology provides practical results that serve as valuable tools for designing and optimizing ASPs. By accurately calculating component capacities based on load requirements and operational patterns, this approach ensures the reliable provision of electricity in off-grid locations. The practical outcome of this research enables the sustainable use of solar energy in remote areas, reducing the financial and labor costs associated with conventional power supply solutions.

articleTitle: Management of liquefied natural gas distribution based on the logistic infrastructure of European and African countries
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: The Russian full-scale invasion of Ukraine in 2022 prompted European countries to implement economic sanctions against Russia to address the ongoing conflict. In response, Russia resorted to manipulating gas deliveries to Europe, leading to changed contracts, gas flow limitations, and artificial restrictions. Given the importance of reliable energy partners, European countries started urgently developing a plan of action to reduce Russian gas consumption. The existing network of export and import LNG terminals could offer a viable solution for partially replacing Russian gas. This paper focuses on a case study that explores the optimal transportation solution for LNG gas in the Mediterranean Sea region, utilising the existing infrastructure of Europe and Africa. The study formulates the problem as a linear programming transportation task, seeking to minimize costs and maximize efficiency, considering port capacities, gas demands of individual countries, and distances between transportation points. Additionally, the paper considers the scalability of the proposed optimisation task to accommodate changing energy demands and supply patterns.

articleTitle: Transformation of Lifelong Digital Education in the Context of Sustainable Development of Society
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: The article examines the theoretical, methodological and analytical aspects of the transformation of lifelong digital education in the context of sustainable development of society. The authors summarized the main approaches to the transformation of digital education and indicated the peculiarities of digital education in Ukraine, and also revealed trends in the development of digital education in the EU and Ukraine. The proposed methodological provisions for the study of digital competences among students allowed to establish a strategy for acquiring digital competences as a partial assimilation of digital skills using the Monte Carlo simulation method. As a result, the study confirmed the need for continuous improvement and deepening of digital competences throughout life as a result of their partial assimilation.

articleTitle: Industry 5.0: Digital Technologies in the Performance Management
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: The paper deals with the results of performance management research in the companies of Ukraine. The level of digital technologies impact on the efficiency of the company's employees was illustrated. Business has become an active participant in numerous technological and innovative changes. To achieve competitive advantages through the use of human potential, companies use performance management. In addition, it will ensure the guest experience and offer positive lasting experiences. At the same time, global trends towards the digitalization of social relations have increased the need for the implementation of possible intelligent systems both in management business processes and communications, and in services. The objective of the paper is to map the prerequisites and possibilities of using digital technologies in performance management in Ukrainіan companies. The study conducted a survey of managers of large companies to determine the factors influencing the performance management system in the context of military operations based on the modification of the PEST analysis and SWOT analysis methodologies. The article proves the hypothesis that the development of performance management positively depends on digital technologies usage in business processes and proposes a system of technologies and tools for managing the performance of companies. The challenges of using performance management in Ukrainіan companies under martial law are investigated. Thus, this study is relevant both for scientific study and has practical value

articleTitle: Development and Research of an Automatic System for Regulating the Frequency of Rotation of a Diesel Engine Crankshaft
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: The article is in an experimental model of an all-mode MR with PID regulation and electromechanical VM, providing a torque of 1.4 Nm at 36º of shaft rotation and without a gearbox. The minimum the ADCs of number and digital inputs of the microprocessor unit has been wired - at least 4 digital and 4 analog inputs.An algorithm has been developed for calculating the cyclic fuel supply with all-mode adjustment for a mathematical model of an electronic ARCH diesel engine with all-mode adjustment, taking into account the dynamic simulation of the CM, a sub-algorithm for regulating the fuel cyclic supply, maintaining the tilt angle of the regulatory branch and reproducing the influence of diesel vibrations. The adequacy of the mathematical model in statics and dynamics is confirmed.An experimental-computational research methodology has been developed to determine rational PID parameters, taking into account operating conditions autotractor diesel engine, confirmed by non-motorized and motorized studies on an engine diesel 4CHN12/14. The result of the study was a three-dimensional array of values of the proposed complex correction factor KΣ for PID MR components.In the process of research, an increase in diesel vibrations at crankshaft speeds n = 0.9…1.06 was established. With these values (n=0.9…1.06), an increase in the P share is necessary to ensure diesel stability. For a 4ChN12/14 diesel engine, the share of P must be increased by 2…2.5 times with a degree of regulator unevenness of 0…6%. After non-motorized tests, it is recommended to correct the PID components on a engine diesel in the ranges n = 0.5…0.9 and 0.9…1.06 relative speeds. The crankshaft by reducing the proposed complex correction factor KΣ from 5% to 2% each. The developed method for setting PID parameters is confirmed by the results of test roads.It is determined that the increase in fuel consumption with an increase in external vibrations is non-linear. With external vibrations of the HPFP rails with an amplitude of 1…3 mm, a decrease in the I-component leads to reduced consumption fuel. Based on the results of modeling transient processes, a fuel saving of 2.25% was obtained. The developed all-mode controller corresponds to the first class of ARCH accuracy.

articleTitle: On-Board Method for Helicopters Turboshaft Engines Neuro-Fuzzy Fuel Consumption Control
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: The focus of this research is the advancement of a neuro-fuzzy control method for managing the fuel consumption of helicopters turboshaft engines. This method employs an adaptive neuro-fuzzy system that incorporates the Sugeno fuzzy inference system in the structure of a five-layer neural network for direct signal propagation. As a result, it enables real-time control of helicopters turboshaft engines fuel consumption with an impressive accuracy of 99.2 %. It has been proven that the hybrid method training the neural network in 105 times less epochs than the backpropagation algorithm. Utilizing the neuro-fuzzy method to regulate the fuel consumption of helicopters turboshaft engines results in a reduction in both first and second type errors, ranging from 1.34 to 5.17 times when compared to alternative neural network architectures. Increasing the outputs number of the ANFIS neuro-fuzzy network and expanding the base of fuzzy rules makes it possible to improve the decision-making logic and, as a result, expand the range of rule activity levels calculating. The prospect of further research is the introduction of the developed methods and algorithms into a modified closed onboard helicopters turboshaft engines automatic control system.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence in Ensuring the Business Economic Security
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: Economic security of business is a complementary category that includes, in particular, energy provision. Numerous blackouts confirmed its importance for the functioning of the economy and its subjects in Ukraine, 2022. Therefore, the issue of ensuring the security of the functioning and development of the energy industry is at the level of national security. It is the basis of existence and creation of products and services for business entities. The historical lessons of energy disasters have demonstrated the need to find effective technologies for the interaction of business and the energy sector of Ukraine, which allow predicting, preventing and eliminating the consequences of accidents and incidents, balancing between environmental and economic security, as well as preventing the loss of human life and health. Such questions become relevant for scientific research and practical tests due to artificial intelligence and its symbiosis with human potential. The article reveals the components of business economic security and substantiates the key aspects of the energy sector in the system of business economic security. There is offered a range of software products using artificial intelligence and machine learning to support management decisions. Artificial intelligence has the potential to be a key factor in the business sector transformation, in particular, helping to achieve a more sustainable, efficient and sustainable energy future.

articleTitle: Measuring Engineering Students' Emotional Competence With Qualimetric Instruments
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: The paper is dedicated to engineers' emotional competency (EC) assessment examined through emotional intelligence (EI). The aim of the work was to provide learners with self-evaluation tools for life-long learning, represented by qualimetric instruments to evaluate EC. The research focuses on engineers’ EC components factor value in relation to future or experienced work. Firstly, the data were collected via Hall’s EI questionnaire based on the Emotional Intelligence Model. The respondents were will-be engineers (N=47) at higher educational institutions and engineers (N=12) with working experience employed in the electric engineering business sector. Secondly, the differences between future engineers’ levels of EC as well as experienced’ engineers’ levels of EC were analyzed. Thirdly, the study proposed the qualimetric instruments to evaluate engineers’ EI in relation to the perceived importance of EC components. The respondents were future engineers (N=15) specialized in electric and power engineering. In order to justify how the factors in the whole model of engineers’ EC are distributed, the assessment of the factors was calculated with the conformance index value. The study implications and limitations can be used as a perspective for future research.

articleTitle: A Comparative Analysis of Transient Analysis Results for DC-DC Regulator in PSpice, Tina, and LTspice
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: The paper presents a comparative analysis of the simulation results of a DC-DC buck regulator based on LM2595 on three different simulation platforms: PSpice, LTspice, and Tina. The comparative analysis includes visual comparison of selected waveforms, comparison of statistical parameters of the observed signals, and comparison based on time step signal analysis. The simulation was performed using three different maximal time step conditions. The research focused on examining the differences caused by different simulation platforms under the same maximal time step condition, as well as the differences caused by different maximal time step conditions within a single simulation platform. This analysis is crucial, particularly when comparing different simulation Spice models that require simulations to be conducted on various simulation platforms. By comparing the results obtained from different platforms under the same simulation conditions, the impact of the simulation platform on the accuracy and behavior of the models can be assessed.

articleTitle: Features of the Car Wheel Rims Manufacturing Technology for Electric Cars
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: It is shown that the regeneration of electric current during the movement of the vehicle is used in electric cars and hybrids when reducing the speed with the help of regenerative braking. This increases the range of such cars. However, the possibilities of electricity production in such cases are not exhaustive. In the active operation process the rim-disk system heats up and, accordingly, this heat can be converted into an additional power source. But during such discs production the technological regimes of the production process should be strictly adhered to in order to obtain quality products. By means of the profiling operation theoretical analysis the most influential structural and technological factors of the process have been established, which makes it possible to design the most optimal manufacturing operations and to minimize defects at the preparatory stages. Analyzed materials from which the rims of the vehicles wheels are currently made, from the most efficient thermoelectric element formation point of view.

articleTitle: Digital Marketing Communications Transformation in Wartime
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: The paper reveals the potential for transformation of digital marketing communications in times of war and provides recommendations on how to effectively use these changes to achieve business success. The necessity of developing adaptive strategies for successful digital marketing communications in wartime is established. This includes identifying key factors to consider, as well as using tools and methods that allow businesses to effectively interact with consumers and maintain their competitiveness. The importance of transforming digital marketing communications in wartime to support business, ensure security and the ability to adapt to changes in the digital communication environment is considered. The study of social media as a digital communications tool revealed which platforms have become popular for obtaining information, while others have become popular for online shopping. A significant presence of target audience identified on social media was found, which indicates the importance of focusing marketing efforts on this segment, as well as supporting women's activity and loyalty on social media. It is found that trends that emerge in times of war should be used for positive purposes. A mechanism for adapting digital marketing communications is proposed, which will ensure the preservation of business, attracting new audiences, increasing competitiveness and preserving reputation. Such a mechanism will allow businesses to adapt to changes in wartime, meet the changed needs of consumers and respond quickly to negative events.

articleTitle: Parametric Synthesis of Fractional Order Controllers for a Two-Mass Electromechanical Fire Lifts Basket Turning System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: In practice, the fire lifts arrow is a complex and not completely rigid object. Imperfect manufacturing of mechanical elements and their connections, elastic deformations of the arrow during operation, reactive action of fire-extinguishing substances cause elastic oscillations when the basket is moved. A promising method of damping elastic vibrations of the arrow is the use of an automatic control system. The synthesized ACS driven by the movement of the arrow should provide the following requirements: static and dynamic accuracy of reproduction of given trajectories, high speed, smooth acceleration and braking of the motor, the necessary margin of stability, absence of significant over-regulation in transition modes, low sensitivity to coordinate and parametric disturbances, etc. To meet these requirements, a number of fundamentally different ACSs and methods of their synthesis were analyzed. As a result of the analysis by the method of the generalized characteristic polynomial, a positional three-loop system of subordinate control by the rotation of the basket was synthesized, taking into account the elastic properties of the basket with the arrow. The synthesized system of subordinate control allows damping of elastic oscillations, providing optimal transitional processes of basket rotation and low sensitivity, in steady state, to the action of disturbances. The transition functions of the angular speed controllers of the motor and basket, which were obtained in the process of synthesis, are of a high order and turned out to be quite complex from the point of view of practical implementation. It is proposed to replace these controllers with more compact PI<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">λ</sup>D<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">μ</sup> controllers or fractional order controllers. Conducted research through mathematical modelling confirmed the effectiveness of replacing high-order angular speed controllers of the motor and basket with fractional-order controllers or PI<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">λ</sup>D<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">μ</sup>-controllers, the transfer functions of which are determined by approximating the transition functions of the controllers using the genetic algorithm method.

articleTitle: Innovative Approaches To Electrical Engineering Field Career Guidance With The Kahoot Toolkit At The National Technical University "Kharkiv Polytechnic Institute"
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: The article describes the experience of National Technical University "Kharkiv Polytechnic Institute" of dealing with the gap between actual demand for energy and electrical engineers and the real number of students, who chose these specialties. It describes the strategy and innovative approaches for potential applicants, that was developed at University during 2017 – 2023 years. All of them are fully based on the gamification and show high results.
