This article offers a systematic approach to the implementation of game forms of interaction using the toolkit of the online platform "Kahoot" in career guidance and the educational process. The methods and technical tips are given.

articleTitle: Improving the Reliability of Elements of Energy Installations when Combustion of Different Quality Fuel
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: In this work, approximation dependences of the pollution intensity specific indicators, which arise under the influence of main parameters characterizing pollution processes, were presented. The results of research were subjected to statistical processing, which confirmed that the increase in the mass of pollutants mainly depends on the content of sulfur and water in the water-fuel oil emulsion. The dependences of the contamination rate on the wall temperature during the burning of fuel and water-fuel oil emulsion for 8 and 1000 hours were also obtained. These dependencies indicate how quickly the available contaminants increase when the wall temperature changes. However, it should be noted that the assessment of the transfer correctness of the obtained data from the experimental plant to the real utilization boilers of power plants is an important step. This means that the results obtained at the experimental plant should be transferred to real conditions of application, namely to waste boilers. This process requires further evaluation and may depend on many factors such as plant size, fuel characteristics, pollution control methods, etc. Therefore, before applying the obtained results in real conditions, their suitability and adequacy should be carefully evaluated.

articleTitle: Formal Training of University Students with the Application of the Arduino Platform for Engineering Problem Solving
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: The aim of the work is to consider the formal training of university students using the Arduino platform for engineering problem solving. The other purpose of the work is the research is to use interactive technologies and to improve the practical experience of students in the process of educational internship at the end of the 2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">nd</sup> year of study of a higher educational institution, to deepen their scientific and practical skills through the use of the Arduino platforms. The article considers the issue of improvement of students’ practical experience in the course of educational internship using the Arduino microcontroller for engineering problems solving. The proposed method to conduct the educational internship is an element of interactive learning techniques that will allow students to deepen their knowledge, acquire and consolidate their practical experience, and to turn the student into an active participant in the learning process, showing their initiative and revealing creative and intellectual potential. The computerized soil irrigation system developed by students during their internship will allow to analyze the quality of plants growth and prevent their disease. The article compares the operation of a YL69 sensor and a capacitive humidity sensor. The created automated system can be expanded both systematically (for any agrarian enterprises) and functionally (to increase the number of sensors for the development by students in the process of internship), as well as to use this technology for other specialized tasks. Development of any automated systems based on microcontrollers is of a huge potential for IT professionals. All this will provide a great deal of practical experience for future IT professionals who will do real practical work, as well as improve the quality and yield of cultivating different crops which will bring significant profit.

articleTitle: Investigation of Mechanical Characteristics of Towers Made of Composite Materials for Their Application in Electrical Networks of Ukraine
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: The analysis of the properties of modern composite materials and the characteristics of towers made of such materials has made it possible to determine the advantages of using fibreglass and basalt plastic towers in electrical networks, which contributes to the spread of composite towers in electrical networks of all voltage classes. An analysis of the world experience of introducing towers made of composite materials was carried out, which showed a steady trend towards an increase in the number of such towers in electrical networks located in remote areas and in areas with difficult climatic and natural conditions. Mathematical modelling of the mechanical characteristics of the state of intermediate and anchor towers made of composite materials was performed, which allows taking into account the peculiarities of load distribution along the tower during its operation in certain climatic conditions, as well as the properties of structures made of polymeric materials during their deformation. Using the proposed mathematical models, the mechanical and technical characteristics were calculated as a result of deformations due to various impacts that are typical for the operation of the investigated towers. The analysis of the determined parameters is carried out and the necessity of taking into account the properties of towers made of composite materials for the development of design standards for power lines with such towers is substantiated.

articleTitle: Management of Information Support and Automation of Energy Systems based on Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: This article investigates the impact of artificial intelligence (AI) on information support and automation in energy systems. It adopts a multi-method approach, combining literature review, case studies, and data analysis to explore various AI techniques and their applications in the energy sector. The findings show that AI-based tools can enhance the prediction, optimization, extraction, analysis, and recommendation of energy-related data, leading to improved efficiency, reliability, and sustainability of energy systems. The article also discusses AI technologies such as deep learning, reinforcement learning, and Internet of Things (IoT) integration, which offer novel opportunities for information support and automation in the energy sector. The article provides practical recommendations on the implementation of AI tools in energy systems, highlighting best practices and key considerations.

articleTitle: Artificial intelligence as a tool of local self-government and democracy development during the formation of Industry 5.0 and Society 5.0
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: The article examines the development of digital technologies through the prism of forming Industry 5.0 and Society 5.0. Technological changes lead to a significant transformation of all life processes, and the process of democratization is considered a positive and targeted trend. The development of democratization processes in different countries is studied through the lens of the development of artificial intelligence. Using digital transformations requires considering several risks and applying new management tools. The advantages and possibilities of using artificial intelligence in public management and local self-government are summarized. Artificial intelligence is regarded as an innovative tool for transforming public administration in the context of improving the efficiency of local democracy.

articleTitle: Photovoltaics: Problems, Challenges, Environmental Feasibility and Efficiency
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 5th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: One of the main directions of the climate goals in the Paris Agreement is the reduction of greenhouse gas emissions into the atmosphere to prevent global warming. Unfortunately, today we already see how nature is changing due to human influence on it. Therefore, in order to avoid even greater environmental damage, the world's energy infrastructure must change today, with an emphasis on environmental friendliness and efficiency. This opportunity is provided by solar energy, which is an ecologically clean energy source compared to traditional energy sources. The improvement of technologies for the production of solar modules and components for solar power plants, as well as the correct design of energy systems based on photovoltaic elements, are very relevant for all environmentally oriented countries of the world. The article considers the main external problems of photovoltaics, which do not allow this industry to become on par with traditional sources of energy. Based on the results of the analysis, the problems of solar energy in the energy supply of large autonomous systems, such as a city, were established. The design of solar power plants, both autonomous and connected to the grid, does not take into account the global issues of electricity consumption and production, which creates the problem of not needing a lot of energy during the day when solar power plants operate, and maximum energy consumption during peak hours when the sun is no longer shining, resulting in to the grid connection of traditional energy sources, thus reducing the environmental impact to a minimum or making it worse. Options for solving problems with an emphasis on environmental friendliness and efficiency are proposed. A number of internal problems of the sphere, which must be solved in parallel with external ones, are also considered. An example of the use of large-scale solar power plants in autonomous mode is given. The expediency of using photovoltaic sources of electricity generation from the point of view of their productivity and environmental friendliness has been established on the example of the electricity supply of the ecological city of the future.
